blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: During the deep learning era, innovations in remote sensing (RS) vision models primarily focused on optimizing network architectures for specific tasks and conducting end-to-end training. However, with the advent of the Vision-Language Models (VLMs) era, constrained by substantial computational resource demands, the mainstream research paradigm has shifted towards adapting general-purpose VLMs using RS vertical domain data for fine-tuning, rather than modifying their core architectures. This transition marks a change in the innovation pathway from model-centric to data-centric. Despite the increasing importance of data, the academic community still lacks a systematic, data-centric survey to guide researchers in constructing high-quality RS vision-language datasets for various application scenarios and in conducting effective model fine-tuning and performance evaluation based on these datasets. To address this gap, this paper presents a systematic review of the development status of RS datasets tailored for VLMs. It further provides a comprehensive practical guide for RS researchers in the large model era, covering the entire pipeline from data construction to fine-tuning and evaluation. This paper aims to encourage the academic community to build more diverse and higher-quality vision-language datasets for specialized RS sub-fields. Ultimately, the goal is to converge these efforts into a comprehensive RS vision-language corpus that offers extensive task coverage and a wide geographical distribution, thereby laying a solid data foundation for advancing towards general artificial intelligence in RS.
blocks.zh: 在深度学习时代,遥感(RS)愿景模型的创新主要侧重于优化特定任务的网络架构和开展端到端培训. 然而,随着愿景-语言模型(VLM)时代的到来,受到大量计算资源需求的制约,主流研究范式已经转向利用RS垂直域数据来调整通用VLM,而不是修改其核心架构. 这一转变标志着创新途径从以模型为中心转向以数据为中心。 尽管数据的重要性越来越大,但学术界仍然缺乏系统、以数据为中心的调查,以指导研究人员为各种应用情景建立高质量的RS视觉语言数据集,并根据这些数据集进行有效的模型微调和性能评价。 为了弥补这一差距,本文件系统地审查了为甚高频数据专门设计的RS数据集的发展状况。 它还为大模型时代的塞族共和国研究人员提供了全面的实用指南,涵盖从数据构建到微调和评价的整个管道. 本文旨在鼓励学术界为专业的RS子领域建立更加多样化和高质量的视觉语言数据集. 最终目标是将这些努力合并成一个全面的塞族共和国愿景语言教程,提供广泛的任务范围和广泛的地域分布,从而为推进塞族共和国的一般人工智能奠定坚实的数据基础。

blocks.en: The advent of large-scale pretraining techniques [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] has ushered in artificial intelligence’s era of foundation models [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Within this context, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in cross-modal understanding and generation, establishing themselves as foundational architectures across numerous research domains. However, the enormous parameter counts and substantial computational requirements of these models render direct architectural modifications for specific vertical domains [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] , such as remote sensing (RS) [ 13 , 14 ] , prohibitively expensive and technically demanding [ 15 , 16 ] . Consequently, a significant paradigm shift is underway in the research community: from a model-centric paradigm focused on designing and optimizing model architectures toward a data-centric paradigm centered on domain-specific data curation and efficient adaptive fine-tuning of general-purpose foundation models [ 17 , 18 ] . This transformation implies that high-quality domain-specific data, rather than model architecture itself, has become the critical enabling factor for unlocking the potential of foundation models and addressing specialized tasks [ 19 , 20 ] . In particular, fine-tuning general VLMs with large-scale image-text RS data has become the primary method for achieving advanced functionalities [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 大规模预训技术的出现[1,2,3]开创了人工智能的基础模型时代[4,5,6]. 在这一背景下,远景-语言模型[7、8、9]在跨模式理解和生成方面展现了卓越的能力,成为跨越许多研究领域的基础架构。 然而,这些模型的巨大参数计数和大量的计算要求使特定的垂直域[10、11、12],如遥感[13、14],直接进行建筑改造,费用高昂,技术要求很高[15、16]。 因此,研究界正在发生重大的范式转变:从以模型为中心的范式侧重于设计和优化模型结构,转向以特定领域数据整理和通用基础模型的高效适应微调[17、18]为中心的以数据为中心的范式。 这种转变意味着,针对特定领域的高质量数据,而不是模型结构本身,已成为释放基础模型潜力和处理专门任务[19、20]的关键因素。 特别是,用大规模图像文本RS数据微调一般VLM已成为实现先进功能的主要方法[21,22,23].

blocks.en: Broadly, VLMs for RS cover three major technical branches: 1) contrastive learning-based cross-modal representation models (e.g., RemoteCLIP [ 24 ] ); 2) text-guided RS image generation models (e.g., Text2Earth [ 25 ] ); and 3) Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). The core research boundary of this survey is the third category, MLLMs, as this class of models has driven a paradigm shift in RS data construction from static annotations to free-form instruction dialogues, which is fully aligned with the data-centric perspective of this work. Since 2023, a paradigm shift driven by VLMs has gained significant momentum [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] . Academic institutions and research organizations worldwide are actively engaging in this interdisciplinary field, leading to the creation of numerous large-scale, multi-task, and multimodal vision-language datasets [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] . The field has evolved from foundational works, such as RSVQA [ 32 ] in 2023, to more versatile datasets, like GeoChat-Instruct [ 33 ] in 2024. By 2025, the development of relevant datasets experienced explosive growth [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] , with expectations to enter an intensive launch phase from 2026 onward.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,斯普斯卡共和国的自愿最低水平涵盖三个主要技术部门: 1)具有对比性的基于学习的跨模式表示模型(如:远程CLIP[24]);2)文本制导的RS图像生成模型(如:Text2Earth[25]);3)多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs). 这次调查的核心研究界限是第三类,MLLMs,因为这一类模型推动了RS数据构建的范式转变,从静态说明到自由形式指令对话,这完全符合这项工作的数据中心视角. 自2023年以来,由VLMs驱动的范式转变获得了显著势头[26,27,28]. 世界各地的学术机构和研究组织正在积极从事这一跨学科领域的工作,导致创建了众多大规模、多任务和多模式愿景语言数据集[29、30、31]。 球场从2023年的RSVQA[32]等基础作品发展到2024年的GeoChat-Instruct[33]等多功能数据集. 到2025年,相关数据集的开发经历了爆炸性增长[34,35,36],预计从2026年开始进入密集发射阶段.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , the accelerating pace of innovation is vividly illustrated by a timeline where icons transition from sparse to densely packed, metaphorically shifting from pedestrians and bicycles to cars, aircraft, and rockets, indicating exponential progress. Concurrently, community engagement has become a core driver [ 37 ] . The increasing number of GitHub stars for relevant projects reflects a vibrant open-source ecosystem characterized by continuous release, validation, and iteration cycles. A fundamental shift in task paradigms is also evident: dataset nomenclature has evolved from conventional detection [ 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] and segmentation [ 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 , 48 ] to encompass advanced tasks requiring complex cognition, such as instruction tuning [ 49 , 50 , 51 , 52 , 53 ] , visual reasoning [ 54 , 55 , 56 , 57 ] , video understanding [ 58 , 59 , 60 , 61 , 62 ] , and geospatial tasks [ 63 , 64 , 65 , 66 , 67 ] . These trends collectively signal an emerging consensus: the integration of visual and linguistic reasoning is transforming satellite perception from mere seeing to genuine insight, heralding a new era of general-purpose RS intelligence. This data-driven research surge not only underscores the maturation of multimodal intelligence in RS but also provides a dynamic, rapidly evolving platform for global scholars to collectively advance the field toward higher-level universal perception and comprehension [ 68 , 69 , 70 ] .
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,一个时间表生动地说明了创新步伐的加快,即图标从人烟稀少过渡到人烟稠密,比喻性地从行人和自行车转向汽车、飞机和火箭,表明进步指数。 同时,社区参与已成为核心驱动力[37]。 用于相关项目的GitHub星越来越多,反映了一个充满活力的开源生态系统,其特点是持续释放、验证和迭代周期。 任务模式也明显发生了根本性的转变:数据集术语从常规检测[38、39、40、41、42、43]和分区[44、45、46、47、48]演变而来,包含需要复杂认知的高级任务,如指令调制[49、50、51、52、53]、视觉推理[54、55、56、57]、视频理解[58、59、60、61、62]和地理空间任务[63、64、65、66、67]。 这些趋势共同表明正在形成一种共识:视觉推理和语言推理的结合正在将卫星感知从单纯的目视转变为真正的洞察力,预示着塞族共和国通用智能的新时代。 这种数据驱动的研究激增,不仅突出了塞尔维亚的多式联运情报的成熟,而且为全球学者提供了一个动态的、迅速发展的平台,以便共同推动该领域走向更高水平的普遍认识和理解[68、69、70]。

blocks.en: Existing surveys on RS VLMs [ 7 , 71 , 72 , 73 , 13 ] have predominantly focused on methodological analyses at the model level. However, it is essential to acknowledge that, compared to the deep learning era [ 74 , 75 , 76 , 77 , 78 ] , the design space for architectural innovation in the foundation model era is relatively constrained, with most contributions adopting modular augmentation and integration strategies [ 79 , 80 , 81 ] . The fundamental reason lies in the fact that substantial architectural modifications typically necessitate training from scratch on large-scale data to recover the generalization capabilities acquired from massive general-domain corpora [ 82 , 83 ] . The scale of datasets constructed by researchers for specific scenarios is generally insufficient to support such from-scratch training of foundation models. Even when models trained from scratch achieve satisfactory fitting performance on scenario-specific datasets, they often forfeit the powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities inherent to general-purpose models, arguably one of the most valuable properties of foundation models [ 84 , 85 ] . Although theoretically feasible to incorporate general-domain data for from-scratch training of novel architectures, such research imposes extraordinary computational resource requirements that remain beyond the reach of most academic laboratories [ 16 , 86 ] . Therefore, we contend that in the foundation model era, the core competitive advantage of small-to-medium research teams resides in data rather than models. Furthermore, while several surveys on RS datasets exist, their treatment of RS vision-language datasets lacks sufficient depth [ 87 , 71 ] . Compounding this issue, the explosive growth of RS vision-language datasets in recent years has rendered existing surveys incapable of providing comprehensive coverage of the current landscape [ 7 , 73 ] .
blocks.zh: 关于RS VLM的现有调查[7,71,72,73,13]主要侧重于模型一级的方法分析. 然而,必须承认,与深层学习时代[74、75、76、77、78]相比,基础模型时代建筑创新的设计空间相对有限,大多数贡献采用了模块化增强和整合战略[79、80、81]。 根本原因是,对建筑进行重大改造通常需要从零开始对大规模数据进行培训,以恢复从大规模通用公司获得的通用能力[82,83]。 研究人员为具体情景构建的数据集规模一般不足以支持这种基础模型的切换培训. 即使从零开始训练的模型在情景特定数据集上取得了令人满意的适配性,它们也往往丧失了通用模型所固有的强大的零射一般化能力,可以说是基础模型最有价值的特性之一[84,85]. 虽然在理论上可以将一般域数据纳入小说建筑的切片培训中,但这种研究提出了非同寻常的计算资源要求,但大多数学术实验室都无法做到[16,86]. 因此,我们认为,在基础模型时代,中小研究小组的核心竞争优势在于数据而不是模型。 此外,虽然对RS数据集进行了几次调查,但它们对RS视觉语言数据集的处理不够深入[87、71]。 使这一问题更加复杂的是,近年来塞族共和国的视觉语言数据集爆炸性增长,使现有调查无法全面覆盖当前情况[7、73]。

blocks.en: To address these gaps, this paper presents the first systematic review and taxonomy of RS datasets designed for VLMs fine-tuning, aiming to help researchers accurately grasp the developmental trajectory and frontier trends in this field. Beyond serving as an evolutionary chronicle of RS vision-language datasets, this work aspires to provide a practically valuable reference manual that can genuinely assist researchers in overcoming research bottlenecks. Specifically, researchers urgently need clarity on how to systematically construct, annotate, evaluate, and leverage high-quality vision-language datasets for diverse RS application scenarios [ 88 , 89 , 90 ] , as well as how to select effective fine-tuning strategies [ 91 , 92 , 93 , 94 , 95 ] and conduct rigorous performance evaluation [ 28 , 96 , 8 , 97 ] based on such high-quality data. The absence of such guiding knowledge has, to a certain extent, led to redundant data construction efforts, ad hoc fine-tuning practices, and fragmented evaluation standards, thereby hindering effective knowledge accumulation and efficient technological iteration within the field.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,本文件介绍了为微调甚高频而设计的RS数据集的第一次系统审查和分类,目的是帮助研究人员准确掌握这一领域的发展轨迹和前沿趋势。 除了作为塞族共和国愿景语言数据集的演化编年史之外,这项工作还希望提供一份实际有价值的参考手册,真正协助研究人员克服研究瓶颈。 具体而言,研究人员迫切需要明确如何系统地构建、注释、评价和利用高质量的远景语言数据集,用于不同的RS应用情景[88、89、90],以及如何选择有效的微调战略[91、92、93、94、95],并根据这些高质量数据进行严格的绩效评价[28、96、8、97]。 由于缺乏这种指导性知识,在某种程度上导致了数据构建的重复努力、临时性的微调做法以及零散的评价标准,从而阻碍了该领域的有效知识积累和高效的技术迭代。

blocks.en: To address the aforementioned challenges, this paper proposes a novel Data Curation research framework, GeoChef, which draws a systematic analogy between the development process of RS VLMs and culinary procedures. Within this framework, we reconceptualize the role of the researcher as a Chef who must not only possess keen observational acuity for iterative model optimization but also engage deeply in every stage of data selection and processing. The framework encompasses four key phases. The first phase, Ingredient Atlas, systematically establishes a taxonomic structure for RS vision-language datasets and analyzes the characteristics and evolutionary patterns of different data types. Just as a chef must thoroughly understand the properties of each ingredient, researchers must familiarize themselves with the task attributes and applicable scenarios of various RS data modalities. The second phase, Ingredient Processing, provides a comprehensive methodology for constructing the dataset. Analogous to ingredient preparation in cooking, raw RS data must undergo multiple processing stages to ultimately yield refined, well-annotated, high-quality datasets that preserve the professional characteristics of RS data while conforming to the format specifications required for MLLM training [ 98 , 99 ] . The third phase, Cooking Manual, elaborates on the selection and implementation of dataset fine-tuning strategies, enabling researchers to choose optimal fine-tuning approaches based on specific task requirements and resource constraints. The fourth phase, Gourmet Tasting, establishes a comprehensive evaluation framework that introduces commonly used benchmarks and multidimensional evaluation metrics for different tasks [ 100 , 101 , 102 ] . This evaluation approach resembles the professional assessment of culinary critics, attending to both overall performance and fine-grained details. Throughout the entire research cycle, the Chef (researcher) consistently assumes the central role of observation and iterative optimization, progressively mastering the complete methodology to customize high-performance VLMs for specific RS application scenarios through continuous experimentation, evaluation, and refinement. Through this framework, this paper provides RS researchers with end-to-end guidance from data preparation to model evaluation, facilitating the transformation of researchers from passive data consumers to proactive GeoChef, ultimately enabling qualitative leaps in RS MLLM performance. The main contributions of this paper are threefold:
blocks.zh: 为应对上述挑战,本文提出了新的数据校准研究框架GeoChef,在RS VLMs的开发过程和烹饪程序之间作系统类比. 在这个框架内,我们重新构思研究人员作为主厨的作用,他不仅必须具有对迭代模型优化的敏锐观察敏锐性,而且还必须深入参与数据选择和处理的每一阶段。 该框架包括四个关键阶段。 第一阶段Informedient Atlas系统为RS视觉语言数据集建立分类结构,并分析不同数据类型的特点和演化规律. 正如厨师必须彻底了解每种成分的特性一样,研究人员必须熟悉各种RS数据模式的任务属性和适用情景。 第二阶段,即材料处理,为构建数据集提供了一个全面的方法。 与烹饪中的成份制备类似,原始的RS数据必须经过多个处理阶段,最终产生精细、说明周全的高质量数据集,以保持RS数据的专业特征,同时符合MLLM培训所需的格式规格[98,99]. 第三阶段"烹饪手册"详细介绍了数据集微调战略的选择和实施,使研究人员能够根据具体的任务要求和资源限制选择最佳微调方法. 第四阶段,Gourmet Tasting,建立了一个全面评价框架,为不同任务引入了常用基准和多层面评价衡量标准[100,101,102]. 这种评价方法类似于对烹饪批评者的专业评估,既注重总体表现,又注重细节。 在整个研究周期,主厨(研究人员)始终承担观察和迭代优化的中心作用,通过连续的实验、评价和完善,逐步掌握将高性能VLM定制为具体的RS应用情景的完整方法。 通过这个框架,本文为RS研究人员提供了从数据准备到模型评价的端到端的指导,促进了研究人员从被动数据消费者向主动的GeoChef的转变,最终使得RS MLLM性能得以质的飞跃. 3. 本文件的主要贡献有三:

blocks.en: • More than 120 publicly available vision-language datasets in the field of Earth observation are systematically surveyed, with detailed categorization and in-depth analysis conducted according to task types. • A dynamic, community-driven data warehouse is constructed, support the addition of independent datasets by researchers and enabling multidimensional retrieval, which significantly improves the efficiency of discovering and accessing RS vision-language datasets. • A step-by-step practical guide is provided for researchers in RS, covering the entire process from data preparation to model evaluation, thereby promoting the development of RS vision-language models toward greater specialization and practicality.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II introduces the taxonomy and a tree diagram of remote sensing vision-language datasets. Section III elaborates on the details of task-oriented datasets and their evolution trends. Section IV proposes a community-driven repository to facilitate efficient data access for researchers. Section V reviews three mainstream methodologies for constructing datasets. Section VI discusses common fine-tuning strategies for vision-language models. Section VII outlines benchmarks and evaluation metrics for assessing the model. Section VIII presents future research directions. Section IX concludes the paper. The overall framework follows a logical progression from fundamental concepts and methodologies to evaluation and outlook.

blocks.en: This survey provides a systematic analysis of over 100 collected vision-language datasets. Figure 1 illustrate the growth trend of RS vision-language datasets over the past five years. The emergence of MLLMs has significantly accelerated the expansion of RS vision-language data. Notably, the number of RS vision-language datasets doubled from 2023 to 2024. Furthermore, the number of new datasets introduced solely in 2025 has surpassed the cumulative total of all such datasets created before that year. The growth rate observed in 2025 exceeds an exponential pattern, indicating that the field of RS vision-language datasets is currently experiencing a phase of rapid expansion. Additionally, Figure 2 illustrates the distribution of publications related to existing RS vision-language datasets. Aside from works posted on the arXiv preprint server, TGRS is the preferred journal for such papers, accounting for 19 publications. It is followed by journals and conferences such as ISPRS and NeurIPS. Moreover, leading venues, including AAAI, CVPR, GRSM, ICCV, ICLR, and ECCV, have also published research on RS vision-language datasets. This publication distribution suggests that peer-reviewed work in this field generally maintains high quality and attracts broad attention from reputable forums.

blocks.en: II-A Taxonomy
blocks.zh: II-A 分类学

blocks.en: In existing surveys on RS VLMs, a common practice is to categorize tasks based on model capabilities. However, we observe that such a capability-oriented taxonomy is inherently non-exhaustive and lacks completeness. Whenever new research emerges, it necessitates continuous supplementation of new capability types, resulting in a classification system that remains in a state of passive expansion. To address this limitation, this paper shifts perspective to the forms of data input and output, proposing a data-centric taxonomy for RS vision-language tasks.
blocks.zh: 在现有的关于RS VLMs的调查中,一个常见的做法是根据模型能力对任务进行分类. 然而,我们认为,这种注重能力的分类方法本身并非详尽无遗,而且缺乏完整性。 每当出现新的研究,就需要不断补充新的能力类型,从而形成一种仍然处于被动扩张状态的分类系统. 为解决这一局限性,本文将视角转向数据输入和输出的形式,为RS视觉语言任务提出了以数据为中心的分类法.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , this framework categorizes tasks into three major types, distinguished by their conventional definitions in the RS community and distinct evaluation metrics: • Image Captioning is primarily evaluated using text similarity metrics , since there often exist multiple valid and natural descriptions for an image, making a simple binary “correct/incorrect” judgment infeasible. • VQA is uniquely evaluated by objective binary correctness , judging whether the model’s response to multiple-choice, true/false, or open factual questions is definitively right or wrong. • Visual grounding inherits the evaluation paradigm of classic object detection and segmentation tasks, using spatial overlap metrics to quantify alignment between predictions and ground-truth annotations.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,本框架将任务分为三大类,以它们在塞族共和国社区中的传统定义和不同的评价衡量标准加以区分: 图像说明主要使用文本相似度衡量标准加以评价,因为图像往往有多种有效和自然的描述,使得简单的二进制“正确/不正确”判断不可行。 · VQA通过客观的二进制正确性进行独特的评价,判断模型对多重选择、真实/虚假或公开的事实问题的反应是否绝对正确。 • 支助 视觉地面继承了经典物体探测和分区任务的评价范式,使用空间重叠度量法量化预测和地面真实说明之间的一致.

blocks.en: Furthermore, each task category can be subdivided according to the granularity of the image region being processed into image-level, region-level, and pixel-level subcategories. Additionally, by extending the input from a single image to multiple images, corresponding temporal tasks can be constructed to accommodate the needs of dynamic scene analysis and change detection. Based on these three dimensions – task type, regional granularity, and temporal dynamics – we systematically organize existing RS vision-language tasks into three major categories and 16 subcategories.
blocks.zh: 此外,每个任务类别可以根据正在处理的图像区域的颗粒性细分成图像级、区域级和像素级亚类。 此外,通过将输入从一个图像扩展到多个图像,可以构建相应的时间性任务,以适应动态场景分析和变化检测的需求. 基于这三个层面 — — 任务类型、区域颗粒性和时间动态 — — 我们系统地将现有的RS视觉语言任务分为三大类和16个子类。

blocks.en: II-B Tree Diagram of Existing RS Vision-Language Datasets
blocks.zh: II-B 现有RS视野-语言数据集树图

blocks.en: To facilitate researchers in quickly locating datasets of each subcategory, we have created a tree diagram as illustrated in Figure 4 . This diagram, comprising three hierarchical levels, vividly showcases the developmental panorama of the current RS visual language domain, and its structure inherently reveals several profound patterns. The most prominent characteristic is the blurring and restructuring of task boundaries. A single dataset frequently appears under multiple seemingly distinct task branches. For instance, EarthDial-Instruct [ 103 ] is simultaneously present under description, classification, and localization. This is not a classification error, but rather reveals a core trend. The research paradigm in the field is shifting from serving single tasks towards constructing multi-task general-purpose datasets capable of handling description, question answering, localization, and classification. The aim is to train or evaluate more general RS foundation models.
blocks.zh: 为方便研究人员快速查找每个子类的数据集,我们制作了一个树图,如图4所示。 这个图由三个层次组成,生动地展示了目前RS视觉语言域的发展全景,其结构内在地揭示了几种深刻的规律. 最突出的特点是任务界限模糊和调整. 单一数据集经常出现在多个似乎截然不同的任务分支之下。 例如,EarthDial-Instruct [103]在描述、分类和本地化下同时存在。 这不是一个分类错误,而是揭示了一个核心趋势。 该领域的研究范式正在从服务单一任务转向构建能够处理描述、回答问题、本地化和分类的多任务通用数据集。 目的是培训或评价更广泛的塞族共和国基金会模式。

blocks.en: Within this trend, VQA has indisputably become the hub and main battleground of the field. In the diagram, the VQA branch not only has the finest subcategories and contains the most datasets, but has also spurred the creation of numerous specialized evaluation sets often named with terms like Bench or Eval. This signifies the field’s entry into a mature stage of systematically assessing model capabilities, where the research focus shifts from whether a function can be implemented to how capable and comprehensive the model is. Simultaneously, the organizational principle of the tree diagram is distinctly marked by the domain-specific characteristics of RS. It is not simply divided by image-text modalities but is rooted in tasks, and particularly emphasizes two dimensions less standard in other visual fields: Geo-referencing and Temporal sequencing. This intuitively suggests that understanding spatial location and change perception are the core challenges and value propositions of RS visual language research. Finally, the names of the datasets themselves form a concise history of the field’s development. High-frequency terms such as RS, SAR, Geo, and Earth indicate data sources. Terms like Cap, VQA, and VG define core tasks, while Instruct, Bench, and size indicators such as 1M or 10M reveal the current hotspots of instruction tuning, performance benchmarking, and large-scale pre-training, respectively. The entire map clearly delineates a developmental trajectory from specialized to general-purpose, from single-task to multi-task, and from training-driven to evaluation-driven.
blocks.zh: 在这个趋势中,VQA无可争议地成为了战地的中心和主要战场. 在图中,VQA分支不仅拥有最好的亚类,并包含最多的数据集,还催生了众多专业评价集的创建,其名称往往与Beach或Eval等术语相同. 这表明外地进入了系统评估模型能力的成熟阶段,研究的重点从能否执行某项职能转移到模型的能力和全面性。 同时,该树图的组织原则明显地以塞族共和国具体领域的特点为标志。 它不仅被图像文本模式分割,而且根植于任务中,特别强调其他视觉领域中标准较低的两个维度: 地理参考和时间测序。 这直观地表明,理解空间位置和变化感知是RS视觉语言研究的核心挑战和价值命题. 最后,数据集的名称本身构成实地发展的简明历史。 诸如RS、SAR、Geo和Earth等高频术语表示数据来源。 Cap,VQA,VG等术语定义了核心任务,而Istruct,Teach,以及1M或10M等大小指标分别揭示了当前教学调试,性能基准,以及大规模预训的热点. 整个地图清楚地描绘了从专门目的到一般目的、从单一任务到多任务以及从培训驱动到评价驱动的发展轨迹。

blocks.en: III The Evolution of RS Vision-Language Datasets
blocks.zh: 三. 塞族共和国远景-语言数据集的演变

blocks.en: This section provides a detailed sequential introduction to five categories of datasets, Image Captioning, VQA, VG, Comprehensive Data, and Benchmark, along with an analysis of their developmental trends. In each subsection, we present the detailed information of the corresponding existing RS vision-language datasets in a table.
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍五个类别的数据集,即图像说明、VQA、VG、综合数据和基准,并分析其发展趋势。 在每一小节中,我们在一个表格中列出相应的现有的RS视觉语言数据集的详细资料。

blocks.en: III-A Evolution of RS Captioning Datasets
blocks.zh: 三-A 说明数据集的演变

blocks.en: Image captioning, one of the earliest vision-language multimodal tasks in RS, aims to describe the content of RS images using natural language. Existing RS image captioning datasets can be broadly categorized into five classes, as outlined in the taxonomy of Figure 5 . Each of these classes will be elaborated on in this section. The development of these datasets, as chronicled in Table I , shows a trajectory from small-scale, single-modality collections to large-scale, diverse, and complex data corpora.
blocks.zh: 图像字幕是塞尔维亚语最早的视觉语言多式联运任务之一,旨在用自然语言描述塞尔维亚语图像的内容. 现有的RS图像字幕数据集可以大致分为5类,如图5的分类学概述. 本节将阐述每一类。 如表一所示,这些数据集的发展显示了从小规模、单一模式收集到大规模、多样化和复杂的数据公司的轨迹。

blocks.en: III-A 1 Captioning & Retrieval
blocks.zh: III-A 1 说明和检索

blocks.en: In original image captioning tasks, the model is required to generate corresponding textual descriptions from input images. For cross-modal retrieval tasks, the model must identify the most relevant text descriptions given images (image-to-text retrieval) or retrieve the most matching images based on text queries (text-to-image retrieval). Early RS datasets did not distinguish between these two tasks, with each sample typically comprising a single RS image paired with a concise textual caption. Foundational datasets like UCM-Captions and Sydney-Captions [ 136 ] , created via automatic pipelines, and the manually annotated RSICD [ 127 ] exemplify this category. They established the basic paradigm of single-sentence, image-level description for RGB imagery, with scales ranging from a few thousand to tens of thousands of image-caption pairs.
blocks.zh: 在原始图像标题任务中,需要模型从输入图像生成相应的文字描述. 对于跨模式检索任务,模型必须确定给定图像最相关的文本描述(图像到文本检索),或者根据文本查询(文本到图像检索)检索最匹配的图像. 早期的RS数据集没有区分这两个任务,每个样本通常由一个RS图像组成,并配有简明的文字标题. 通过自动管道创建的UCM-Captions和Sydney-Captions[136]等基础数据集,手动注释的RSCD[127]就是这个类别的例子. 他们确立了单一判决的基本范式,RGB图像的图像级别描述,比例尺从几千到数万的图像封装对.

blocks.en: III-A 2 Detailed Captioning
blocks.zh: III-A 2 详细说明

blocks.en: With the increasing adoption of LLMs, the captions generated in new datasets have exhibited significant improvements in both textual length and semantic richness (incorporating multiscale spatial relationships and domain-specific terminology). This evolution reflects the growing complexity of vision language alignment requirements in RS applications. Recent large-scale datasets are pivotal for pre-training robust vision-language models. For instance, RS5M [ 126 ] provides 5 million captions, and RSTeller [ 146 ] offers over 2.6 million image-caption pairs. Furthermore, datasets like GeoLangBind-2M [ 109 ] and MMM-RS [ 120 ] have expanded beyond RGB to include diverse modalities (e.g., SAR, MS, DEM, IR, NIR), capturing richer geospatial semantics. This trend towards massive scale and multi-modality, as seen in SkyScript (2.6M captions) [ 135 ] and RemoteCLIP [ 24 ] , is crucial for developing foundational models with deep domain understanding.
blocks.zh: 随着越来越多地采用LLMS,新数据集中产生的标题在文字长度和语义丰富度(包括多尺度的空间关系和特定领域的术语)上都显示出显著的改进。 这一演变反映了RS应用程序中视觉语言一致性要求日益复杂. 近期的大规模数据集对于培训前的强健视觉语言模型至关重要。 例如,RS5M[126]提供500万个字幕,RSTeller[146]提供260多万对图像封装。 此外,GeoLangBind-2M[109]和MMM-RS[120]等数据集已超出RGB范围,包括多种模式(如搜索和救援系统、MS、DEM、IR、国家清单报告),捕捉更丰富的地理空间语义。 如SkyScript(2.6M标题)[135]和ReptectCLIP[24]所示,这种大规模和多式联运的趋势对于开发具有深域理解的基础模型至关重要。

blocks.en: III-A 3 Region Captioning
blocks.zh: III-A 3 区域说明

blocks.en: Region captioning distinguishes itself from conventional image captioning by focusing on generating textual descriptions for specific image regions, typically delineated through bounding boxes. This localized approach enables the precise characterization of individual objects or regions of interest, which is particularly valuable for complex visual analysis tasks in RS applications. Datasets supporting this task, e.g, Falcon_SFT [ 106 ] and GeoLLaVA [ 152 ] , require fine-grained annotations that link phrases or sentences to specific areas within an image. This represents a move towards more structured and object-aware textual descriptions compared to global image captioning.
blocks.zh: 区域字幕通过注重生成特定图像区域的文字描述,典型的是通过边框划定,从而将自身与常规图像字幕区分开来. 这种局部化的方法能够准确描述个别物体或感兴趣的区域,这对于斯普斯卡共和国应用中的复杂的视觉分析任务特别有价值。 支持这项任务的数据集,如Falcon_SFT[106]和GeoLLAVA[152],需要精细的刻度说明,将短语或句子链接到图像中的特定区域. 与全局图像字幕相比,这是向更有条理和更加了解对象的文字描述的一步。

blocks.en: III-A 4 Grounding Captioning
blocks.zh: III-A 4 定位说明

blocks.en: Grounding Captioning represents an advanced form of detailed image captioning that not only generates comprehensive descriptions of visual content, but also provides precise spatial locations (bounding boxes or masks) for each described object in the image. This technique imposes significant challenges, as it requires the model to establish an accurate point-to-point correspondence between textual descriptions and their corresponding visual elements in the image space. This task can be performed at either the region level or the pixel level, depending on whether the target objects are represented by bounding boxes or masks. It is a natural extension of region captioning with an explicit localization requirement. The creation of such datasets is an active research area, e.g, EarthDial-Instruct [ 103 ] and GeoPixelD [ 154 ] , and often builds upon the foundational data from large-scale captioning collections.
blocks.zh: 地面说明(Grounding Captioning)是一种详细图像标题的高级形式,它不仅产生视觉内容的全面描述,而且为图像中每个描述的对象提供精确的空间位置(边框或口罩). 这一技术带来了巨大的挑战,因为它要求模型在图像空间的文字描述及其相应的视觉元素之间建立精确的点对点对应. 这项任务可以在区域级别或像素级别上完成,这取决于目标对象是用边框还是面具表示. 这是区域标题的自然延伸,有明确的本地化要求。 这类数据集的创建是一个活跃的研究领域,例如EarthDial-Instruct [103] 和GeoPixelD [154],并经常以大型字幕集的基础数据为基础.

blocks.en: III-A 5 Temporal Captioning
blocks.zh: III-A 5 临时说明

blocks.en: Temporal captioning tasks process sequential image inputs (either multiple still frames or video sequences) to generate coherent descriptions of temporal dynamics. In RS applications, the most prominent implementation is change captioning derived from change detection datasets, which requires models to summarize object-level transformations (e.g., construction progress, land cover changes, or disaster impacts) across temporal observations. This task presents unique challenges in spatiotemporal reasoning. Datasets like LEVIR-CC [ 153 ] , a multi-temporal change captioning dataset with over 50k captions, are specifically designed for this purpose. Other resources like CapERA [ 151 ] , a video captioning dataset, also support modeling temporal sequences. The evolution in this category focuses on capturing what has changed in addition to what is there.
blocks.zh: 时间性字幕任务处理相继的图像输入(或者多个静帧或者视频序列),以生成对时间动态的一致描述. 在RS应用中,最显著的实现是从变化检测数据集中衍生出来的变化标题,这需要模型在时间观察中总结对象层面的转变(如施工进度,土地覆盖变化,或灾害影响). 这项任务在瞬间推理方面提出了独特的挑战。 LEVIR-CC [153] 等数据集是一个多时变化字幕集,有超过50k个字幕,专门设计用于此目的. CapERA[151]等其他资源,一个视频字幕数据集,也支持模拟时间序列. 这一类别的演化侧重于捕捉除了其中的变化之外的变化。

blocks.en: In summary, the development of RS image captioning datasets has evolved from early, small-scale collections with brief, image-level captions for basic tasks towards large-scale, semantically rich corpora that support complex multimodal understanding. This progression is marked by a significant expansion in data volume and caption complexity, driven by advances in foundation models. The focus has shifted to more sophisticated objectives, including fine-grained region description, precise visual grounding, and temporal dynamics analysis. Concurrently, datasets have increasingly incorporated diverse data modalities beyond optical imagery, and annotation methodologies have transitioned from manual efforts to automated, model-assisted processes, collectively enabling deeper and more structured geospatial language-vision alignment.
blocks.zh: 简言之,RS图像字幕数据集的开发从早期小规模的集成,为基本任务配有简短的图像级字幕,发展到支持复杂多式联运理解的大规模、精致丰富的公司。 这一进展的特点是,在基础模型的推动下,数据量和标题的复杂性显著扩大。 重点已转向更复杂的目标,包括精细的区域描述、精确的视觉定位和时间动态分析。 同时,数据集越来越多地纳入光学图像以外的多种数据模式,注释方法已从人工努力过渡到自动化、模型辅助进程,共同促进地理空间语言-视觉更加深入和结构更加一致。

blocks.en: III-B Evolution of RS VQA Datasets
blocks.zh: RS VQA 数据集的演变

blocks.en: VQA is one of the most common tasks in vision-language multimodal research. It is generally categorized into three types: multiple-choice, true/false (binary), and open-ended questions. Among these, multiple-choice and true/false questions are objective and can be evaluated using accuracy as the primary metric. In contrast, open-ended questions often have non-unique answers, necessitating a variety of evaluation methods. For short-form answers consisting of only one or two words, content-based accuracy can be used, i.e., the prediction is considered correct if it includes any ground-truth word; otherwise, it is marked incorrect. In addition, synonym-based similarity metrics, such as those used in Next-QA [ 209 ] , can be employed to account for semantic equivalence. However, for longer open-ended responses, these metrics become less reliable. In such cases, it is common to resort to evaluation using LLMs [ 145 ] or human judges [ 148 ] to assess the quality and relevance of the generated answers. We categorize existing RS VQA datasets into five primary types, which are described in detail below. This categorization aligns with the taxonomy of vision-language data shown in Figure 6 . The mainstream datasets for these categories are summarized in Table II , showing a clear evolution in scale, modality, and task complexity over the years. Below, we describe each category in detail, referencing key datasets from the table.
blocks.zh: VQA是视觉语言多式联运研究中最常见的任务之一. 一般分为三类:多选择、真/假(二进制)和开放式问题。 其中,多选择和真实/虚假的问题是客观的,可以使用精确度作为主要衡量标准来评价. 与此相反,开放式问题往往有非同寻常的答案,因此需要采用各种评价方法。 对于只包含一个或两个单词的短式答案,可以使用基于内容的精确度,即如果预测包含任何地面真实词,则被认为正确;否则,它被标记为不正确. 此外,基于同义词的类似度度量,如Next-QA [209]中使用的等效度量,可以用于计算语义等同. 然而,在较长的开放式反应中,这些指标的可靠性降低。 在这种情况下,通常使用LLMs[145]或人文法官[148]来评估所生成的答复的质量和相关性。 我们将现有的RS VQA数据集分类为五种主要类型,以下详细介绍. 这一分类与图6所示的视觉语言数据分类一致。 表二汇总了这些类别的主流数据集,显示这些年来在规模、方式和任务复杂性方面的明显变化。 下面我们详细描述每个类别,参考表中的关键数据集。

blocks.en: III-B 1 Scene Classification
blocks.zh: III-B 1 场景分类

blocks.en: Scene classification is a domain-specific task in RS, aimed at identifying the land cover type or land use category of an entire image. In the context of vision-language data, scene classification datasets can be viewed as a special form of VQA, where each image is associated with a predefined question—typically fixed across the dataset (e.g., What is the scene type?) —and a corresponding answer label. Unlike general-purpose VQA tasks that involve diverse and image-specific questions, RS scene classification VQA is characterized by its standardized question format and categorical answer space. This structure enables the integration of scene classification into multimodal learning frameworks under the vision-language paradigm. While not all datasets in Table II are exclusively for scene classification, several early and foundational datasets, such as the RSVQA series (RSVQA-LR/HR) [ 32 ] and RSIVQA [ 175 ] , incorporate true/false questions that can be framed as binary classification queries about high-level scene attributes (e.g., Is there a residential area?). This serves as a bridge connecting traditional scene classification to the VQA paradigm.
blocks.zh: 场景分类是塞族共和国的一个特定领域任务,旨在识别整个图像的土地覆盖类型或土地利用类别. 在视觉语言数据的背景下,场景分类数据集可以看作是VQA的一种特殊形式,每个图像都与预先定义的问题相关联——典型地固定在了整个数据集(例如,场景类型是什么?)——以及相应的答案标签. 与涉及多样和图像特异性问题的通用VQA任务不同,RS场景分类VQA的特点是其标准化的问题格式和绝对的答案空间. 这种结构使现场分类能够纳入远景语言范式下的多式联运学习框架。 虽然表二中并非所有数据集都完全用于场景分类,但一些早期和基础数据集,例如RSVQA系列(RSVQA-LR/HR)[32]和RSIVQA[175],都包含了真实/虚假的问题,可以被设定为关于高层场景属性的二进制分类查询(例如是否有住宅区?). 这是连接传统场景分类与VQA范式的桥梁.

blocks.en: III-B 2 VQA
blocks.zh: III-B 2 VQA

blocks.en: In RS image-level VQA tasks, each data sample typically consists of an image, a question, and a corresponding answer. This encompasses the most common form of VQA, dealing with questions about the image content without explicit region reference. As shown in Table II, a vast majority of datasets focus on this task. The field has evolved significantly from early datasets like RSVQA-LR (77k Q&As) [ 32 ] to recent large-scale ones such as HRVQA (1.07M Q&As) [ 167 ] and OSVQA (1.13M Q&As) [ 174 ] , demonstrating a clear trend towards increased data volume. The questions are typically free-form (FRE), true/false (T/F), or multiple-choice (CHO). Another notable trend is the expansion of data modalities, from primarily RGB in early works to incorporating multispectral (MS), synthetic aperture radar (SAR), and multi-temporal (MT) data in datasets such as EarthVQA [ 162 ] , OSVQA [ 174 ] , and CDVQA [ 186 ] . Automated and semi-automated data generation methods have been crucial in scaling up dataset sizes, as seen in RSVQAxBEN (14.76M triples) [ 176 ] . A prominent and challenging subtype within image-level VQA is counting, which involves estimating the number of objects (e.g., vehicles, airplanes) in a scene. Dedicated datasets like RemoteCount (828k Q&As) [ 24 ] have been created for this purpose. Since the answers are integers, counting is considered a form of short-form open-ended VQA. However, standard accuracy is an inadequate metric for evaluation, as it treats all incorrect counts equally, failing to reflect the magnitude of error. Therefore, regression-based metrics like Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) are more appropriate, as used in REO-VLM [ 210 ] .
blocks.zh: 在RS图像级别VQA任务中,每个数据样本一般由一个图像,一个问题和一个相应的答案组成. 这包含最常见的VQA形式,处理有关图像内容的问题,没有明确的区域参考. 如表二所示,绝大多数数据集都侧重于这项任务。 该字段从早期的数据集如RSVQA-LR(77k QQAs)[32]到近期的大规模数据集如HRVQA(1.07M QQAs)[167]和OSVQA(1.13M QQAs)[174]都有显著发展,显示出数据量增加的明显趋势. 问题通常是自由形式(FRE)、真实/虚假(T/F)或多重选择(CHO)。 另一个值得注意的趋势是数据方式的扩展,从早期工程中主要是RGB,到将多光谱(MS),合成孔径雷达(SAR)和多时段(MT)数据纳入EarthVQA [162],OSVQA [174],CDVQA [186]等数据集. 如RSVQAxBEN(14.76M tribels)[176]所示,自动和半自动数据生成方法对扩大数据集规模至关重要。 图像级VQA中一个突出且具有挑战性的子类型正在计数,这涉及到估计一个场景中物体的数量(如车辆,飞机). 为此创建了专用数据集,如远程政务(828k QQAs)[24]. 由于答案是整数,计数被认为是一种短式的开放式VQA. 然而,标准准确性不足以衡量评价,因为它对所有不正确的计数一视同仁,未能反映错误的严重程度。 因此,如REO-VLM [210] 中使用的基于回归的度量衡,如根平均平方误差(RME)和平均值绝对误差(MAE)更为恰当.

blocks.en: III-B 3 Region VQA
blocks.zh: 3个地区

blocks.en: Region-level VQA differs from image-level VQA in that the question explicitly refers to a specific region within the image. This explicit reference can be conveyed in two primary ways: (1) through natural language questions that include coordinate references in textual form [ 106 ] , or (2) via visual prompts such as bounding boxes or markers overlaid on the image [ 147 ] . The explicit specification of regions acts as a strong visual cue, which can mitigate the referential ambiguity present in standard image-level VQA. Recent datasets are increasingly incorporating this capability. For instance, GeoLLaVA [ 152 ] and GeoPlan-Bench [ 165 ] are constructed to support region-level understanding and reasoning, where questions or instructions are tied to specific spatial areas within the RS imagery, enabling more precise and interpretable queries.
blocks.zh: 区域级的VQA与图像级的VQA不同,因为问题明确指图像内的特定区域. 这种明确提及可以通过两种主要方式传达:(1)通过自然语言问题,包括以文字形式提供的坐标参考[106],或(2)通过图像上绑有边框或标记的视觉提示[147]。 明确区域说明是一个强烈的视觉提示,可以减轻标准图像级别VQA中存在的偏差模糊。 最近的数据集越来越多地纳入了这一能力。 例如,GeoLlaVA[152]和GeoPlan-Bench[165]的构建是为了支持区域一级的理解和推理,其中的问题或指示与RS图像中的特定空间领域挂钩,从而能够进行更准确和可解释的查询。

blocks.en: III-B 4 Grounding VQA
blocks.zh: III-B 4 地面勘测

blocks.en: Grounding VQA refers to a task that combines VG and VQA. The model is required not only to provide an answer to a given question but also to localize the corresponding answer region within the image, as illustrated in Figure 6 . Compared to conventional VQA, this imposes greater demands on the model, as it must both infer the correct answer and accurately identify the specific image region (bounding boxes) that supports it. Models trained on such data exhibit enhanced interpretability, as the localized regions provide visual evidence. In RS, datasets such as LRS-GRO [ 170 ] and QAG-360K [ 185 ] are designed explicitly for this joint task, requiring the model to generate a bounding box or mask corresponding to the answer for a given question. This represents a more advanced and spatially-grounded form of VQA.
blocks.zh: 地基VQA是指结合VG和VQA的任务. 如图6所示,该模型不仅需要为特定问题提供答案,而且需要将图像中相应的答案区域本地化。 与常规VQA相比,这对模型提出了更大的要求,因为它既必须推断出正确的答案,也必须准确识别支持它的特定图像区域(边框). 接受过这类数据培训的模型显示出了更高的可解释性,因为局部区域提供了视觉证据。 在RS中,LRS-GRO[170]和QAG-360K[185]等数据集是专门为这一联合任务设计的,要求模型生成一个与特定问题的答案相对应的边框或面具. 这代表着一种更加先进和空间化的VQA形式.

blocks.en: III-B 5 Temporal VQA
blocks.zh: III-B 5 临时VQA

blocks.en: With the growing capability of vision-language models to process sequential data, temporal VQA tasks have emerged. These tasks take multiple images (often forming a video or a temporal sequence) as input and require models to derive answers by analyzing temporal relationships, changes, or dynamics. In RS, most existing temporal VQA datasets are constructed from change detection data, focusing on queries about pre- and post-disaster comparisons or urban development. Reflecting this trend, recent datasets begin to incorporate temporal or video data. For example, CDVQA [ 186 ] uses bi-temporal images for change-related Q&A. More recent datasets, such as BEDI [ 158 ] , are built upon aerial video imagery, requiring mathematical reasoning over dynamic scenes. Similarly, UrbanVideo-Bench [ 179 ] and MM-UAVBench [ 173 ] utilize video data to support tasks that require temporal understanding, such as tracking and action recognition, thereby pushing the boundaries of RS VQA from static imagery to spatiotemporal analysis.
blocks.zh: 随着视觉语言模型处理顺序数据的能力不断增强,时间VQA任务也随之出现. 这些任务以多个图像(通常形成视频或时间序列)作为输入,需要模型通过分析时间关系,变化,或动态来得出答案. 在塞族共和国,大多数现有的时间性VQA数据集是从变化检测数据中构建出来的,侧重于对灾前和灾后比较或城市发展的询问. 为了反映这一趋势,最近的数据集开始纳入时间或视频数据。 例如CDVQA [186] 使用双时态图像进行与变化相关的QQA. 较近的数据集,如BEDI[158],是建立在航空视频图像上,需要数学推理而不是动态场景. 同样,UrbanVideo-Bench[179]和MM-UAV Bench[173]利用视频数据支持需要时间理解的任务,如跟踪和行动识别,从而将RS VQA的边界从静态图像推向瞬间分析.

blocks.en: Overall, the development of RS VQA datasets is characterized by increased scale, richer modalities, and greater task complexity. The field has progressed from foundational, manually-constructed datasets to large-scale, automatically generated benchmarks, as evidenced by the growth in the number of samples. There is a significant diversification in data modalities, expanding from standard RGB to include multispectral, SAR, and video data. Concurrently, the VQA task formulations have evolved beyond basic image-level question-answering to incorporate more complex types such as region-referenced, grounded, and temporal VQA.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,RS VQA数据集的开发特点是规模扩大,模式更加丰富,任务更为复杂. 实地已经从基础的、人工构建的数据集发展到大规模、自动生成的基准,样品数量增加就证明了这一点。 数据模式有显著的多样化,从标准的RGB扩大到包括多光谱、合成孔径雷达和视频数据。 同时,VQA任务提法已经超越了基本的图像层面的问答,纳入了比较复杂的类型,如区域参考、基础和时间VQA。

blocks.en: III-C Evolution of RS Visual Grounding Datasets
blocks.zh: RS视觉定位数据集的演变

blocks.en: RS VG aims to use natural language expressions to locate specific objects (in the form of bounding boxes or segmentation masks) in RS images, thereby enhancing human interaction with intelligent RS interpretation systems. As shown in Figure 7 , the evolution of datasets has been pivotal in driving progress in this field. In practical applications, different objects and scenarios necessitate different grounding representations: an HBB can coarsely localize an object’s position, and a mask precisely depicts its shape. As summarized in Table III , a variety of large-scale RS visual grounding datasets have emerged recently, spanning from 2022 to 2025. Early research primarily focused on HBBs, as seen in datasets like RSVG [ 191 ] and DIOR-RSVG [ 188 ] . However, as the field advances, more diverse grounding types are being adopted to meet complex application needs. Newer datasets increasingly support segmentation masks, such as RefSegRS [ 204 ] , RRSIS-D [ 201 ] , and the large-scale GeoSeg-1M [ 196 ] . This shift reflects the growing demand for more precise, pixel-level localization. The annotation methodologies have also evolved, ranging from manual and semi-automatic to fully automatic data pipelines, significantly improving annotation efficiency and scale. Concurrently, the diversity in GSD and the sheer volume of samples in these datasets have greatly enhanced the robustness and applicability of the developed models.
blocks.zh: RS VG旨在使用自然语言表达,在RS图像中定位特定对象(以边框或分区口罩的形式),从而增强人类与智能RS解释系统的互动. 如图7所示,数据集的演变是推动这一领域取得进展的关键。 在实际应用中,不同的物体和情况需要不同的定位表示:六溴代二苯可以粗略地定位物体的位置,而面具则精确地描绘物体的形状。 如表三所概述,最近出现了各种大规模的塞族共和国视觉地面数据集,范围从2022年到2025年。 早期的研究主要集中于六溴代二苯,如RSVG[191]和DIOR-RSVG[188]等数据集中可见. 然而,随着实地工作的进展,正在采用更加多样化的基础类型来满足复杂的应用需要。 更新的数据集越来越支持分区口罩,如RefSegRS [204],RRSIS-D [201],以及大规模GeoSeg-1M [196]. 这一转变反映了对更精确,像素级本地化日益增长的需求. 注释方法也有所发展,从人工和半自动数据管道到全自动数据管道,大大提高了注释效率和规模. 同时,GSD的多样性以及这些数据集中样本的数量之大,极大地增强了所开发模型的稳健性和适用性.

blocks.en: III-C 1 Referring Expression Comprehension (REC)
blocks.zh: III-C 1 参考表达理解(REC)

blocks.en: The input to REC is an RS image paired with a referring expression, and the output is a single corresponding bounding box of the uniquely referred object in the image. Most early datasets (e.g., RSVG [ 191 ] , DIOR-RSVG [ 188 ] , and GeoText-1652 [ 189 ] ) typically describe objects using their relative positions within the image, as well as appearance attributes such as color, size, and shape. Subsequently, AVVG [ 187 ] has shifted its focus toward referential description based on 3D spatial locations and fine-grained attributes of vehicles. This evolution addresses the need for precise object localization and identification in complex urban environments. For the REC task, the IoU between the predicted bounding box and the ground truth box is directly employed as the evaluation metric. Alternatively, a threshold (e.g., IoU   0.5) can be set to compute accuracy, where a prediction is correct if its IoU exceeds the threshold.
blocks.zh: 对REC的输入是一个RS图像与引用表达式对齐,输出是图像中唯一引用对象的单个对应的边框. 大部分早期数据集(如RSVG [191],DIOR-RSVG [188],以及GeoText-1652 [189])通常描述物体在图像中的相对位置,以及外观属性如颜色,大小,形状等. 随后,AVVG [187]将重点转向基于3D空间位置和车辆精细纹饰属性的优惠描述. 这一演变解决了在复杂的城市环境中精确对象本地化和识别的必要性. 就区域环境中心的任务而言,在预测的界限框和地面真相框之间的IoU直接用作评价的衡量标准。 或者,可以设定一个阈值(例如IoU 0.5)来计算准确性,如果预测的IoU超过阈值,则该阈值是正确的.

blocks.en: III-C 2 Generalized REC (GREC)
blocks.zh: 区域经共体

blocks.en: GREC extends REC to multi-object localization and hallucination detection, where no referred object exists. This formulation is more aligned with real-world applications. GeoChat-Instruct [ 33 ] represents an early example of a GREC dataset in the RS domain. Notably, conventional RS object detection can be viewed as a specialized GREC task where the referring expressions are predefined object categories. Common object detection metrics, such as Mean Average Precision (mAP), require confidence scores, which many MLLMs do not provide natively. To address this, LMMRotate [ 211 ] introduces mAP nc and mF 1 metrics designed for models without confidence scores, which are recommended for evaluating GREC. The development of GREC reflects the field’s progression towards handling more complex and realistic scenarios, where models must not only identify relevant objects but also recognize when no object matches the description, thereby reducing false positives in practical applications.
blocks.zh: GREC将REC扩展为多对象局部化和幻觉检测,在没有参考对象的地方. 这种提法更符合现实世界的应用. GeoChat-Instruct [33] 代表了RS域中GREC数据集的早期实例. 值得注意的是,常规的RS对象检测可以看作是一种专门的GREC任务,其中参考表达式是预先定义的对象类别. 常见的对象检测度量,如Meal Europe Precent(mAP),需要置信分数,而许多MLLM并没有在本地提供. 为了解决这个问题,LMMRotate [211]引入了为没有自信分数的模型设计的mAP nc和mF 1 度量衡,建议用于评价GREC. GREC的开发反映了外地在处理更复杂和更现实的情景方面的进展,即模型不仅必须识别相关的对象,而且必须识别没有对象与描述相符时,从而减少实际应用中的假阳性.

blocks.en: III-C 3 Temporal GREC
blocks.zh: III-C 3 时空GREC

blocks.en: T-GREC extends the input from a single image to multi-image sequences. A canonical example is change detection, where given bi-temporal images, the model must localize changed regions by reasoning across time. This demands spatio-temporal understanding, making it more challenging than standard GREC. To our knowledge, TEOChatlas [ 183 ] is the first and only RS dataset designed to support this specific task. This task requires the model to understand both spatial relationships within individual images and temporal dynamics across image sequences, enabling applications such as urban development monitoring, disaster assessment, and agricultural growth tracking. The complexity of T-GREC lies in the need for joint spatial-temporal reasoning, where models must distinguish actual changes from seasonal variations, illumination differences, and other confounding factors.
blocks.zh: T-GREC将输入从单一图像扩展至多图像序列. 一个犬科的例子就是变化检测,给定的双时段图像,模型必须通过跨时间推理将变化的区域本地化. 这需要时空理解,使其比标准的GREC更具挑战性. 据我们所知,TEOChatlas [183] 是第一个也是唯一的RS数据集,旨在支持这一具体任务. 这项任务要求模型既了解单个图像中的空间关系,又了解跨图像序列的时间动态,使城市发展监测、灾害评估和农业增长跟踪等应用成为可能。 T-GREC的复杂性在于需要共同的时空推理,模型必须区分实际变化与季节性变化,光照差异以及其他困惑因素.

blocks.en: III-C 4 Referring Expression Segmentation (RES)
blocks.zh: III-C 4 参考表达式分离(RES)

blocks.en: Similar to REC, RES aims to localize a uniquely referred object, but it outputs a precise segmentation mask instead of a bounding box. The development of datasets supporting mask output, as shown in Figure 7 , has facilitated research in this direction. Representative datasets include RefSegRS [ 204 ] , AAVG [ 187 ] , and RRSIS-D [ 201 ] . Influenced by the reasoning segmentation tasks [ 79 ] in the field of general MLLMs, research in this domain has begun to exhibit a marked shift from simple explicit reference towards tasks that require reasoning for implicit reference, with notable examples including GRASP-1K [ 197 ] , and GeoSeg-1M [ 196 ] . Evaluation can use an IoU-based accuracy threshold. Standard segmentation metrics such as mean IoU and overall IoU are also applicable for a comprehensive assessment, where IoU is calculated between masks. The transition from bounding boxes to segmentation masks represents a significant advancement in localization precision, enabling applications that require detailed shape information, such as building footprint extraction, crop boundary delineation, and infrastructure monitoring.
blocks.zh: 与REC类似,RES旨在定位一个唯一被引用的对象,但它输出一个精确的分割面罩而不是边框. 如图7所示,开发支持遮罩输出的数据集促进了这方面的研究。 代表性数据集包括RefSegRS [204],AAVG [187],以及RRSIS-D [201]. 受一般MLLMs领域的推理分化任务[79]的影响,这一领域的研究开始显示出一种明显的转变,从简单的明确提及转向需要推理以进行隐含提及的任务,其中显著的例子包括GRASP-1K [197]和GeoSeg-1M [196]. 评价可以使用基于IoU的精确阈值. 诸如IoU和整体IoU等标准分解度量标准也适用于全面评估,IoU在口罩之间计算. 从捆绑箱向分块口罩的过渡,是本地化精度的显著进步,使需要详细形状信息的应用成为可能,如建筑脚印提取、作物划界和基础设施监测。

blocks.en: III-C 5 Generalized RES (GRES)
blocks.zh: 三-C 5 通用RES(GRES)

blocks.en: GRES extends RES to support multiple objects and empty referrals, corresponding to a more generalized node in the task taxonomy. Analogous to how object detection is a form of GREC, RS semantic segmentation can be viewed as a specialized GRES task. The recently proposed RemoteSAM-270K dataset [ 194 ] is a representative benchmark for this task. Since it involves potentially multiple disconnected regions, it generalizes beyond the single-mask output of RES. GRES addresses the practical need to localize multiple objects described in complex natural language expressions, which is essential for applications like inventory counting, damage assessment, and environmental monitoring. The development of GRES datasets and methods reflects the field’s growing maturity in handling more sophisticated referring expressions that may involve multiple objects, complex relationships, and potentially no relevant objects in the image.
blocks.zh: GRES扩展RES支持多个对象和空转介,相当于任务分类学中更通用的节点. 类似对象检测是GREC的一种形式,RS语义分解可视为专门的GRES任务. 最近提议的远程SAM-270K数据集[194]是这项任务的一个代表性基准。 由于它涉及潜在的多个脱节区域,它概括了RES的单任务输出之外的情况。 GRES解决了将复杂的自然语言表达方式描述的多个物体本地化的实际需要,这对于库存计数、损害评估和环境监测等应用至关重要。 GRES数据集和方法的开发反映了字段在处理可能涉及多个对象,复杂关系,且图像中可能没有相关对象的更复杂的引用表达式方面日益成熟.

blocks.en: III-C 6 Temporal GRES
blocks.zh: III-C 6 临时拨款

blocks.en: T-GRES advances the paradigm by requiring segmentation outputs from multiple input images. The primary application is in change detection, where the goal is to segment the changed regions between images taken at different times. This task combines temporal reasoning with precise mask prediction, presenting greater complexity than T-GRES, which only outputs bounding boxes for changes. Datasets ChangeChat-87K [ 53 ] and Falcon_SFT [ 106 ] are currently identified as the two primary benchmarks supporting the T-GRES task. This task requires models to perform fine-grained pixel-level segmentation of changes while ignoring irrelevant variations caused by factors like illumination, season, or sensor characteristics. The emergence of T-GRES represents the cutting edge of RS visual grounding, integrating temporal analysis with precise segmentation to support applications such as monitoring construction progress, assessing disaster impacts, and tracking land use changes over time.
blocks.zh: T-GRES通过要求多个输入图像的分割输出来推进范式. 主要应用在变化探测,目标是在不同时间拍摄的图像之间划分变化区域. 这项任务结合了时间推理和精确的遮罩预测,呈现出比T-GRES更大的复杂性,T-GRES只输出约束框用于变化. 数据集 ChangeChat-87K [53]和Falcon_SFT [106] 目前被确定为支持T-GRES任务的两个主要基准. 这个任务需要模型对变化进行精细的像素级分解,同时忽略照明,季节,或传感器特性等因素造成的不相关的变异. T-GRES的出现代表了RS视觉地面的前沿,将时间分析与精确的分解结合起来,以支持诸如监测施工进度、评估灾害影响和跟踪土地利用随时间推移发生的变化等应用。

blocks.en: In summary, the field of RS VG has undergone rapid evolution. As evidenced by the survey of mainstream datasets, there is a clear trend from early models using horizontal bounding boxes towards recent, more precise segmentation masks, alongside advancements in annotation methods from manual to automatic pipelines. Correspondingly, the task taxonomy has expanded from the foundational REC to include more complex and practical scenarios, such as generalized, temporal, and segmentation-based variants, reflecting the growing sophistication and breadth of application in the research domain.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,RS VG领域经历了快速演变. 对主流数据集的调查表明,从早期模型使用横向边框到最近更精确的分区口罩,以及从人工管道到自动管道的注释方法的进步,都有明显的趋势。 相应地,任务分类从基础REC扩展至包括更复杂和实用的情景,如通用的、时间的和分化的变体,反映出研究领域应用的日益复杂和广泛。

blocks.en: III-D Evolution of Comprehensive Datasets
blocks.zh: 三-D 综合数据集的演变

blocks.en: Beyond the aforementioned single-task RS vision-language datasets, numerous studies have proposed comprehensive datasets and benchmarks supporting multiple tasks to enhance the overall capabilities of MLLMs, as exemplified in Table IV and Table V . Training data are undergoing explosive growth in scale, rapidly escalating from hundreds of thousands of instructions in 2023 to tens of millions (e.g., 11.11 million instructions in EarthDial-Instruct) and even nearly a hundred million (e.g., 78 million instructions in Falcon_SFT) by 2025. The construction methodologies heavily rely on automated pipelines to support this massive scale. Concurrently, data modalities are rapidly diversifying from the early dominance of RGB, with SAR, infrared, multispectral, and even hyperspectral data being widely integrated, fostering specialized datasets for domains like change detection and disaster assessment .
blocks.zh: 除了上述单一任务中的RS远景语言数据集外,许多研究还提出了综合数据集和基准,支持多项任务,以提高MLLM的整体能力,如表四和表五所示。 培训数据的规模正在发生爆炸性增长,从2023年的数十万指令迅速上升至数千万指令(例如,地球指令中的1 111万指令),甚至到2025年达到近1亿指令(例如Falcon_SFT中的7800万指令). 建筑方法严重依赖自动化管道来支持这种大规模建设。 同时,数据模式正在从RGB的早期主导地位迅速多样化,合成孔径雷达、红外线、多光谱数据、甚至超光谱数据被广泛整合,为变化探测和灾害评估等领域培育了专门的数据集。

blocks.en: Currently, RS vision-language data stands on the cusp of a transition from quantitative accumulation to qualitative breakthrough. Its development trajectory is clear: continuous expansion in scale, increasing modality fusion, and more specialized tasks. Future evolution directions are even more defined: First, a balanced emphasis on both scale expansion and quality improvement, enhancing the complexity, diversity, and accuracy of instructions while shifting the paradigm from ”scale-first” to ”quality-and-efficiency parity.” Second, deep multimodal fusion, moving beyond simple juxtaposition of data types towards pursuing cross-modal alignment and synergistic understanding, enabling complementary use of multi-source data in complex tasks like disaster response and land cover change detection. Third, task design is trending towards complexity and practicality, evolving from basic description and Q&A to comprehensive tasks requiring spatiotemporal reasoning, causal analysis, and decision support.
blocks.zh: 目前,塞族共和国的愿景语言数据正处于从数量积累向质量突破的过渡阶段。 其发展轨迹是明确的:规模持续扩大,方式聚变增加,任务更加专业化. 未来的进化方向更加明确: 首先,平衡地强调扩大规模和提高质量,提高指令的复杂性、多样性和准确性,同时将范式从“尺度第一”转向“质量和效率均等”。 第二,深度多式联运,从简单的数据类型并列到追求跨模式对齐和协同理解,使多来源数据在救灾和土地覆盖物变化探测等复杂任务中得到互补利用。 第三,任务设计趋向于复杂性和实用性,从基本描述和QQA演变为需要时空推理、因果分析和决策支持的全面任务。

blocks.en: These trends collectively propel comprehensive datasets to become the cornerstone for training the next generation of powerful and general-purpose RS MLLMs. The core of future evolution will shift from pursuing sheer data volume towards building a new generation of data infrastructure characterized by high quality, deep fusion, strong reasoning capabilities, and effective evaluation. This necessitates closer collaboration among data builders, algorithm researchers, and domain experts to jointly forge a next-generation data system capable of empowering large RS models to achieve deep visual understanding, complex spatiotemporal reasoning, and reliable geospatial decision-making.
blocks.zh: 这些趋势共同推动综合数据集成为培训下一代强大和通用的RS MLLM的基石。 未来发展的核心将从追求完全的数据量转向建设新一代的数据基础设施,其特点是高质量、深度聚合、强大的推理能力和有效评价。 这就要求数据构建者、算法研究人员和域专家之间开展更密切的合作,共同构建下一代数据系统,该系统能够增强大型RS模型的能力,从而实现深刻的视觉理解、复杂的瞬间推理和可靠的地理空间决策。

blocks.en: III-E Demarcation Between Atomic and Composite Datasets
blocks.zh: 三. 原子和复合数据集的划分

blocks.en: With the rapid advancement of MLLMs, a growing number of composite datasets have been introduced, which are constructed by aggregating existing image-text datasets and reformatting them into standardized instruction-following formats. In contrast to atomic datasets, which are built entirely with de novo novel annotations from scratch, composite datasets represent a distinctive data paradigm unique to the era of MLLM.
blocks.zh: 随着MLLMs的迅速发展,引进了越来越多的综合数据集,这些数据集是通过汇总现有图像文本数据集并将其重编为标准化的遵循指令格式来构建的。 与原子数据集相比,复合数据集是MLLM时代特有的一个独特的数据范式,而原子数据集完全从零开始用新的注释构建.

blocks.en: For image captioning datasets, LAION-EO [ 111 ] is constructed by filtering RS images from general image-text pairs, resulting in a Novel Annotation Ratio (NAR) of 0; it is a purely composite dataset. For the LRS2M [ 206 ] dataset, half of its samples are obtained by integrating existing datasets, while the other half are generated via model-based augmentation from short captions, giving it a NAR of 0.5. For VQA datasets, a large number of questions in the RSIVQA [ 175 ] task are generated via template-based transformation—for example, by directly converting RS image classification tasks into VQA tasks—resulting in a NAR of only 0.1. For VG datasets, 30% of the samples in RemoteSAM-270K [ 194 ] are derived from the integration of existing datasets, yielding a NAR of 0.7. For comprehensive multi-modal datasets, the MMRS-1M [ 119 ] and SkyEye-986k [ 212 ] datasets are constructed almost entirely through the integration or transformation of existing datasets. In contrast, all corresponding comprehensive benchmarks have a NAR of 1.
blocks.zh: 对于图像字幕数据集,LAION-EO [111]是通过从一般图像文本对齐中过滤RS图像来构建的,结果产生了0的小说注释比(NAR);它是一个纯粹的复合数据集. 对于LRS2M[206]数据集,其样本的一半是通过整合现有数据集获得的,而另一半则通过基于模型的增强通过短标题生成,给出0.5的NAR. 对于VQA数据集,RSIVQA[175]任务中的大量问题都是通过基于模板的转换生成的——例如,直接将RS图像分类任务转换为VQA任务——结果产生只有0.1的NAR. 对于VG数据集,远程SAM-270K[194]中30%的样本来自现有数据集的整合,得出0.7的NAR. 对于全面的多式数据集,MMRS-1M[119]和SkyEye-986k[212]数据集几乎完全通过现有数据集的集成或转换构建. 相比之下,所有相应的综合基准的NAR为1。

blocks.en: Notably, these two dataset categories are neither mutually exclusive nor mutually antagonistic; instead, they constitute a synergistic, complementary ecosystem that underpins the full development lifecycle of RS VLM. When evaluated solely on their intrinsic contribution at the dataset level, composite datasets do not outperform atomic datasets, yet low-NAR composite datasets deliver a scalable data foundation for large-scale pre-training and model initialization.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,这两个数据集类别既非相互排斥,也非相互对立;相反,它们构成了一个协同互补的生态系统,支撑着斯普斯卡共和国的VLM的整个发展生命周期。 当仅仅根据其在数据集层面的内在贡献来评价时,复合数据集并没有超过原子数据集,但是低NAR复合数据集为大规模预训和模型初始化提供了可扩展的数据基础.

blocks.en: IV Community-Driven Data Warehouse
blocks.zh: 四. 社区驱动数据仓库

blocks.en:
After familiarizing ourselves with existing RS vision-language datasets, we devised a four‑step framework, illustrated in Figure 8 , to support researchers in iterative development, culminating in the creation of GeoChat. For a chef, the first and foremost step is to select the appropriate ingredients. Similarly, for a researcher, the first step is to select the appropriate data according to their specific needs. As shown in Figure 9 , this section
begins by presenting the foundational component of the project: a community‑driven data warehouse.
blocks.zh:
在熟悉了现有的塞尔维亚语远景语言数据集之后,我们设计了一个四个步骤框架,如图8所示,以支持研究人员进行迭代开发,最终创造了GeoChat。 对于厨师来说,第一步是选择合适的配料. 同样,对于研究人员来说,第一步是根据他们的具体需要选择适当的数据。 如图9所示,本节
首先介绍项目的基础部分:社区驱动的数据仓。

blocks.en: Fig. 9: Our Open-source Project maintained on Github.
blocks.zh: 图9:我们的开放源代码 在Github维持的项目。

blocks.en: To address the challenges of fragmented data resources and the discontinuation of maintenance for existing open-source repositories in the field of RS vision-language research, this paper introduces a community-driven open-source data warehouse, Awesome-RS-VL-Data 1 1 1 Awesome-RS-VL-Data , to provide sustained and comprehensive data support for related studies. As an emerging paradigm for data management, the core of a community-driven data warehouse lies in its approach to aggregating, maintaining, and updating data resources through open collaboration, thereby overcoming the limitations in sustainability and scalability inherent in traditional closed databases.
blocks.zh: 为应对零散数据资源的挑战,以及停止维持斯普斯卡共和国愿景语言研究领域的现有开放源码储存库,本文件介绍了一个社区驱动的开放源码数据库,即Asource-RS-VL-Data 1 1 Asource-RS-VL-Data,为相关研究提供持续和全面的数据支持。 作为数据管理的新兴范例,社区驱动的数据仓的核心在于其通过开放合作汇集、维持和更新数据资源的方法,从而克服传统封闭数据库固有的可持续性和可扩展性方面的限制。

blocks.en: The open source of this data warehouse followed a prolonged period of preparation and internal refinement, including an initial trial operation within internal scenarios for over six months. The primary objective was to accumulate a substantial volume of high-quality dataset resources. Through continuous expansion, the repository now hosts more than 120 datasets, establishing a solid foundation for open sharing with the community. Furthermore, recognizing that other open-source repositories 2 2 2 Awesome-Remote-Sensing-Foundation-Models 3 3 3 awesome-remote-sensing-vision-language-models 4 4 4 awesome-vision-language-models-for-earth-observation 5 5 5 Awesome-Remote-Sensing-Multimodal-Large-Language-Model on similar topics have suffered from update stagnation – often due to shifts in research team focus, graduation of core maintainers, or other commitments – leading to data resources failing to keep pace with research advancements, we decided to formally open-source our internally curated and mature dataset inventory. This initiative aims to fill the gap for a sustainably maintained data warehouse in this domain. Moving forward, the core development team will continue to participate in the repository’s updates and improvements, while also leveraging the power of the community to achieve long-term, iterative data refinement.
blocks.zh: 这一数据仓库的开放源头是经过长时间的准备和内部改进之后的,包括在6个月以上的内部设想中进行初步试验。 主要目标是积累大量高质量的数据集资源。 通过持续的扩展,寄存器现在托管了120多个数据集,为与社区公开共享奠定了坚实的基础. 此外,我们认识到其他开放源码库 2 2 Super-Remote-Sensing-Foundation-Models 3 3 award-repotenting-sense-vision-lantial-models 4 4 award-vision-lantis-for-earth-Observation 5 5 5 Super-Remound-Remound-Language-Model 类似主题的更新停滞 — — 往往是由于研究团队重点的转变、核心维护者的毕业或其他承诺 — — 导致数据资源跟不上研究进展的步伐,因此决定正式开放我们内部整理和成熟的数据集目录。 这一举措旨在填补这一领域持续维护的数据仓的空白。 今后,核心开发团队将继续参与存储库的更新和改进,同时利用社区的力量实现长期、迭代的数据完善。

blocks.en: Fig. 10: A community-driven harmonica score library. Currently, 1,388 harmonica scores have been collected, 99% of which were contributed by community users.
blocks.zh: 图10:社区驱动的口琴乐谱库. 目前,已收集到1 388个口琴分数,其中99%是由社区用户提供的。

blocks.en: Compared to traditional private data warehouses, the community-driven model represents the core advantage of this repository. Private data warehouses typically rely on maintenance by specific research teams or individual personnel, making their continuity and updates highly vulnerable to factors such as changes in research direction or turnover of key personnel, often resulting in dataset obsolescence and project abandonment. In contrast, our data warehouse adopts a community-self-maintenance model, opening both the permissions and responsibilities for data upkeep to the entire community. This fundamentally mitigates the sustainability risks associated with a single maintaining entity. The feasibility of this model has been successfully validated through another open-source project we initiated: a harmonica score library 6 6 6 JE Harmonica Score Library . By establishing a unified data format and initially manually extracting and standardizing tablature information before transitioning to community self-maintenance after open-sourcing, this project has stably operated for eight years. The community has spontaneously contributed and maintained nearly 1,400 harmonica tablatures, fully demonstrating the significant advantages of the community-driven model in resource accumulation and project sustainability. Even if the core development team suspends direct maintenance due to unforeseen circumstances, the community can still propel the continuous development of the data warehouse.
blocks.zh: 与传统的私人数据仓库相比,社区驱动的模式代表了这个存储库的核心优势. 私人数据仓库通常依赖特定研究小组或个人的维护,使其连续性和更新极易受到研究方向或关键人员更替变化等因素的影响,往往导致数据集过时和项目放弃。 相比之下,我们的数据仓库采用了社区自我维护模式,为整个社区提供数据维护的许可和责任。 这从根本上减轻了与单一维持实体有关的可持续性风险。 这个模型的可行性通过我们发起的另一个开源项目得到了成功验证:一个口琴乐谱库 6 6 JE口琴乐谱库。 通过建立统一的数据格式,在开源后向社区自我维护过渡之前,初步手动提取并规范了图表信息,该项目已经稳定运行了8年. 社区自发地贡献并维持了近1 400个口琴图册,充分显示了社区推动的模式在资源积累和项目可持续性方面的重大优势。 即使核心开发团队因意外情况暂停直接维护,社区仍然可以推动数据仓的持续开发.

blocks.en: Fig. 11: A mobile app developed based on our data warehouse. It can help researchers real-time grasp the dynamics of RS vision-language datasets.
blocks.zh: 图11:基于我们的数据仓库开发的移动应用程序. 它可以帮助研究人员实时掌握RS视觉语言数据集的动态.

blocks.en: In terms of functional design and user experience, this data warehouse incorporates several distinctive features. First, it employs a multi-dimensional label classification system to finely annotate the included datasets. It enables researchers to quickly locate resources that meet their needs. Second, it adheres to a mechanism of continuous updates, closely tracking research trends in the RS vision-language field and consistently incorporating new datasets and related information. This ensures the timeliness and comprehensiveness of the data resources, providing up-to-date support for research and applications. Third, leveraging the GitHub Issues ecosystem and the official GitHub REST API v3, the warehouse possesses powerful extensibility, supporting third-party platform development. The adaptive website GeoCef, built upon this data warehouse, achieves cross-device compatibility and can be seamlessly used on computers, mobile phones, tablets, and other terminals, as shown in Figure 11 . This allows researchers to utilize fragmented time to track the latest dataset dynamics and search for target resources, thereby providing inspiration and high-quality corpus support for research topic selection and model development.
blocks.zh: 在功能设计和用户经验方面,这个数据仓包含了几个独特的特征. 首先,它使用多维标签分类系统来细化包含的数据集。 它使研究人员能够迅速找到满足其需要的资源。 第二,它坚持不断更新的机制,密切跟踪塞族共和国愿景语言领域的研究趋势,并不断纳入新的数据集和相关信息。 这确保了数据资源的及时性和全面性,为研究和应用提供了最新的支持。 第三,利用GitHub问题生态系统和官方GitHub REST API v3,该仓库拥有强大的扩展性,支持第三方平台开发. 适应性网站GeoCef基于此数据仓库,实现了跨设备兼容性,可以在计算机,手机,平板电脑和其他终端上无缝使用,如图11所示. 这使研究人员能够利用零散的时间跟踪最新的数据集动态并寻找目标资源,从而为研究专题选择和模型开发提供灵感和高质量的成套支持.

blocks.en: In addition to the GitHub-based open-source data repository functionality, the README interface of this project aggregates resources for RS visual language datasets, including access links to papers and data, as well as corresponding references and data links to the original RS datasets. Furthermore, we have compiled a list of recently published large-scale RS vision-language models and incorporated other high-quality Awesome resource lists in this field, aiming to provide researchers with one-stop information support. This community-driven data warehouse not only establishes an efficient data-sharing platform for RS vision-language research but also fosters a virtuous cycle of community contribution, resource accumulation, research empowerment. In the future, we anticipate broader participation from researchers in maintaining and refining the data warehouse, collectively enriching the data ingredients to provide solid support for the innovative development of next-generation RS intelligent models.
blocks.zh: 除了基于GitHub的开源数据存储器功能外,该项目的README接口还汇总了RS视觉语言数据集的资源,包括访问论文和数据的链接,以及与原始RS数据集的相应引用和数据链接. 此外,我们汇编了一份最近出版的大规模RS远景语言模型清单,并纳入了这一领域的其他高质量 " 优秀资源清单 " ,目的是向研究人员提供一站式信息支持。 这种由社区推动的数据仓不仅为塞族共和国的愿景语言研究建立了有效的数据共享平台,而且促进了社区贡献、资源积累和研究授权的良性循环。 今后,我们预计研究人员将更广泛地参与数据仓的维护和完善,共同丰富数据成分,为下一代RS智能模型的创新发展提供坚实的支持.

blocks.en: V Construction of RS Vision-Language Datasets
blocks.zh: 五. 建设RS远景-语言数据集

blocks.en: Dataset construction is the second step to becoming a GeoChef. After selecting the suitable raw data materials, preliminary processing must be performed to prepare for the subsequent cooking process. The construction methodology of RS vision-language datasets is pivotal to their quality and applicability. Based on the level of human involvement and algorithmic automation, mainstream data construction pipelines can be broadly categorized into three paradigms: the completely manual pipeline [ 150 , 128 , 124 , 153 ] , the completely automatic pipeline [ 136 , 21 , 24 , 146 , 109 , 108 , 115 ] , and the semi-automatic pipeline [ 151 , 135 , 207 , 110 , 104 , 144 , 117 ] . The choice among these paradigms involves a fundamental trade-off between data quality, production efficiency, diversity, and the requirement for expert knowledge. The following subsections detail the characteristics, advantages, disadvantages, and typical use cases of each approach.
blocks.zh: 数据集构建是成为GeoChef的第二步. 在选择合适的原始数据材料后,必须进行初步处理,以便为随后的烹饪过程做准备. 塞族共和国愿景语言数据集的构建方法对其质量和适用性至关重要。 根据人的参与程度和算法自动化程度,主流数据建设管道可大致分为三个范式:完全人工管道[150,128,124,153],完全自动管道[136,21,24,146,109,108,115],半自动管道[151,135,207,110,104,144,117]. 这些范式的选择涉及数据质量、生产效率、多样性和对专家知识的要求之间的根本权衡。 以下各小节详细介绍了每种方法的特征,优点,缺点和典型使用案例.

blocks.en: V-A Manually Data Pipeline
blocks.zh: V-A 手动 数据管道

blocks.en: The manually data construction pipeline relies entirely on human experts throughout the entire process. In this paradigm, there is no algorithmic involvement; the generation, cross-validation, and iterative optimization of data samples are all performed by humans. This approach is particularly suited for constructing high-precision, small-sample datasets that demand deep domain expertise, such as benchmark datasets designed for rigorous evaluation. Its foremost advantage lies in the exceptional diversity and high quality of the curated data, as expert knowledge ensures accuracy and richness. However, the primary drawback is its low efficiency and high dependency on skilled human resources, making it prohibitively expensive and impractical for large-scale captioning or generative tasks. A representative successful case of this paradigm is the XLRS-Bench [ 150 ] , a high-quality benchmark for evaluating RS vision-language models.
blocks.zh: 人工数据构建管道在整个过程中完全依靠人类专家. 在这个范式中,没有算法参与;数据样本的生成,交叉验证,迭代优化都是由人类完成的. 这种方法特别适合建造高精度、小样本数据集,这些数据集需要深领域的专门知识,例如为严格评价而设计的基准数据集。 其最大优势在于所整理的数据具有特殊的多样性和质量,因为专家知识确保了准确性和丰富性。 然而,主要缺点是效率低,高度依赖熟练的人力资源,使大规模字幕或基因配置任务费用昂贵,不切实际。 这个范式的一个有代表性的成功例子是XLRS-Bench[150],这是评价RS视觉语言模型的高质量基准.

blocks.en: V-B Automatically Data Pipeline
blocks.zh: V- B 自动数据管道

blocks.en: In contrast, the automatic data construction pipeline operates without any human intervention. It typically starts from existing datasets and employs predefined rules or algorithms to automatically generate templated data samples. This method is highly suitable for building large-scale datasets for repetitive or structured tasks. Its core advantage is high efficiency; once the generation rules and algorithms are verified to be correct, the produced data theoretically requires no manual inspection, enabling rapid scaling. The main disadvantage is the potential lack of data diversity, as the output is constrained by the initial templates and rules. Nevertheless, this limitation can be mitigated by employing LLMs to paraphrase and enrich the generated text. A notable example is the GeoChat [ 33 ] dataset, constructed automatically for geo-localized dialogue.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,自动数据建设管道的运作没有任何人干预。 它通常从现有的数据集开始,并使用预先定义的规则或算法来自动生成模板数据样本. 这种方法非常适合为重复或结构化的任务建造大型数据集. 它的核心优势是效率高;一旦生成规则和算法被核实无误,所生成的数据理论上不需要人工检查,从而能够快速缩放. 主要缺点是可能缺乏数据多样性,因为产出受到初始模板和规则的限制. 然而,通过使用LLMs来解释和丰富生成的文本,可以减轻这种限制。 一个显著的例子是GeoChat [33]数据集,自动构建用于地理定位对话.

blocks.en: V-C Semi-automatically Data Pipeline
blocks.zh: V-C 半自动 数据管道

blocks.en: The semi-automatic pipeline represents a synergistic approach that balances human expertise and algorithmic efficiency, making it the most commonly adopted method in industrial practice. In this paradigm, a model (e.g., a large vision-language model) is primarily responsible for the initial data generation, while human annotators are tasked with verification, correction, and optimization. This collaborative workflow effectively balances speed with quality control. The advantages are significant: it yields diverse data quickly by leveraging the generative capacity of models, while human oversight ensures a reliable quality floor. The key disadvantage is the continued requirement for manual verification, which can be applied either to the full dataset or through sampling, thus incurring non-negligible but manageable labor costs. This approach is exemplified by the construction of the VRSBench [ 149 ] dataset, where model generation was coupled with human review.
blocks.zh: 半自动管道是一种协同方法,它兼顾人的专门知识和算法效率,使其成为工业实践中最常用的方法。 在这个范式中,一个模型(如大型的视觉语言模型)主要负责初始数据生成,而人类的注释者则承担着验证,校正,优化的任务. 这种协作工作流程有效地平衡了速度和质量控制。 其优点是巨大的:它通过利用模型的遗传能力迅速产生各种数据,而人的监督则确保可靠的质量底线。 主要的缺点是继续需要人工核查,这种核查既可以适用于完整的数据集,也可以通过取样进行,从而产生不可忽略但可以控制的劳动力成本。 这种方法的例子是构建了VRS Bench[149]数据集,其中的模型生成与人类审查相结合。
