blocks.en: V-D Analysis about Data Construction Methods
blocks.zh: V-D 数据构建方法分析

blocks.en: Figure 12 quantifies the distribution of multimodal data construction methods. Semi-automation dominates overall at 56.25%, peaking at 65.52% in captioning datasets. Manual annotation varies drastically, reaching its highest share (31.48%) in VQA datasets, driven by the task’s inherent reasoning complexity and demand for precise visual-text alignment. Fully automatic methods remain secondary and stable (15.52%–26.09%), with maximum adoption in the VG dataset, indicating structured-output tasks are more amenable to automation. These patterns reveal a clear correlation between task nature and construction paradigm: description-heavy tasks prioritize semi-automation for scalability, while reasoning-intensive tasks require greater manual intervention. The persistent minority status of automatic methods underscores the fundamental challenge of high-quality unsupervised multimodal data generation, highlighting the need for advanced human-in-the-loop frameworks or generative models to improve efficiency for complex tasks.
blocks.zh: 图12量化了多式联运数据构建方法的分布情况。 半自动化总体占56.25%,在字幕数据集中最高达到65.52%. 人工注释差异很大,在VQA数据集中达到最高比例(31.48%),这取决于任务固有的推理复杂性以及对精确的视觉文本对齐的需求。 完全自动方法仍然是二级的和稳定的(15.522+26.09%),在VG数据集中最大程度的采用,表明结构化输出任务更适合自动化. 这些模式揭示了任务性质和构造范式之间的明显关联:描述式重任务为可伸缩性优先进行半自解,而推理密集型任务则需要更大的人工干预. 自动方法的长期少数地位突出了高质量、不受监督的多式联运数据生成这一根本挑战,突出表明需要先进的人与人间框架或基因模式,以提高复杂任务的效率。

blocks.en: Figure 13 further analyzes model adoption in recent semi-automatic data construction studies. GPT-4o [ 15 ] emerges as the undisputed dominant tool, used in nearly 20 surveyed papers, owing to its robust multimodal capabilities, high instruction fidelity, and reliable API performance—critical for generating coherent, task-aligned synthetic data. Beyond this dominant model, adoption becomes highly fragmented. A secondary tier includes GPT-4V, GPT-4 [ 15 ] , Qwen2-VL [ 86 ] , and GPT-3.5 [ 216 ] . The broader ecosystem remains in an active exploratory phase, with researchers evaluating tradeoffs between the cost-effectiveness of smaller models, customizability of open-source options, and specialized capabilities for specific data types. This has led to adoption of alternatives including Claude-3.5 [ 217 ] , Gemini variants [ 218 ] , and leading open-source vision-language models [ 219 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 图13进一步分析了近期半自动数据构建研究中采用模型的情况. GPT-4o[15]是无可争议的主导工具,在近20份被调查的论文中使用,因为它具有强大的多式联运能力、高度的教学忠诚度和可靠的API性能——对于生成连贯的、与任务相协调的合成数据至关重要。 除了这一主导模式外,收养变得非常分散。 一个二级包括GPT-4V,GPT-4 [15],Qune2-VL [86],以及GPT-3.5 [216]. 更广泛的生态系统仍处于积极的探索阶段,研究人员评估较小模型的成本效益、开放源代码选项的定制性以及特定数据类型的专门能力之间的权衡。 这导致了包括克劳德-3.5 [217],双子座变体 [218],以及领先的开源视觉语言模型[219,16,17,18]在内的替代品的采用.

blocks.en: V-E AI Agent-Driven Data Construction Paradigm and Quality Control
blocks.zh: V-E AI Agent-Driven 数据构建范式与质量控制

blocks.en: The AI agent-driven paradigm represents the next evolutionary stage of semi-automatic data construction, replacing the traditional “single-model generation + human verification” workflow with a collaborative multi-agent system [ 171 , 114 ] that automates complex, multi-step reasoning and curation processes. Unlike single-model approaches plagued by inherent biases and limited reasoning capabilities, multi-agent systems leverage specialized division of labor to achieve higher annotation quality and scalability. As shown in the Figure 14 , the most prevalent and practical implementation is the dual-agent architecture [ 171 ] , consisting of a generator agent producing initial annotations and an independent evaluator agent filtering low-quality or incorrect samples. This separation of generation and evaluation effectively mitigates confirmation bias and overconfidence issues.
blocks.zh: AI代理驱动的范式代表了半自动数据构建的下一个演化阶段,以协作的多代理系统[171,114]取代传统的"单模生成+人验证"工作流程,实现复杂,多步推理和校准过程的自动化. 与受固有偏见和推理能力有限困扰的单一模式方法不同,多代理系统利用专门的分工,实现更高的注释质量和可扩展性。 如图14所示,最普遍和最实际的实施是双剂架构[171],由产生初始说明的生成剂和过滤低质量或不正确的样品的独立评估剂组成。 这种生成和评价的分离有效地减轻了确认的偏见和过度自信问题。

blocks.en: Building on dual-agent systems, recent research has proposed tri-agent architectures to address the challenging task of constructing high-quality chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning data, which is critical for training RS-VL models with advanced spatial and logical reasoning abilities. A representative example is the RS-EoT-4K dataset pipeline [ 114 ] , which employs a Socratic questioning framework involving three specialized agents: Reasoner, Perceiver, and Verifier. The Reasoner is blinded to image content and prompted that its collaborator has ”weak perceptual capabilities”, forcing it to decompose complex spatial problems into simple incremental questions based on local visual features. Conversely, the Perceiver with full image access is prompted that its collaborator has ”weak reasoning capabilities”, compelling it to provide precise, concise answers without extraneous information. Their iterative Q&A exchange naturally unfolds into step-by-step reasoning trajectories, which are finally validated for logical consistency and factual accuracy by the Verifier agent. This self-play-based Socratic approach produces more interpretable and logically sound reasoning traces than direct single-model CoT generation, setting a new benchmark for reasoning-focused RS-VL dataset construction.
blocks.zh: 以双代理系统为基础,近期的研究提出了三代理架构,以解决构建高质量的思维链(COT)推理数据这一具有挑战性的任务,这对以先进的空间和逻辑推理能力培训RS-VL模型至关重要. 一个有代表性的例子是RS-EoT-4K数据集管道[114],该管道采用了一个涉及三个专门代理人的Socratic询问框架:Reasoner、Perceiver和Veriver。 "理性报"对图像内容视而不见,并促使其合作者具有"弱的感知能力",迫使其将复杂的空间问题分解为基于局部视觉特征的简单递增问题. 反之,有完整图像访问的Perceiver被促使其合作者具有“薄弱的推理能力”,迫使其提供准确、简洁的答案,而不提供不相干的信息。 他们的迭代 QQA 交换自然发展成一步步推理轨迹,这些轨迹最终被验证者代理人验证为逻辑一致性和事实准确性. 这种基于自玩的Socratic方法产生比直接的单模型CoT生成更可解释和逻辑上健全的推理痕迹,为注重推理的RS-VL数据集构建设定了新的基准.

blocks.en: Despite these advancements, MLLMs are not infallible. In the RS domain with highly specialized knowledge and ambiguous visual patterns, model-generated annotations inevitably contain errors. Thus, human-in-the-loop quality control remains indispensable for high-quality RS-VL datasets. The traditional human-centric quality control pipeline [ 220 ] consists of four sequential stages: annotator training, initial human annotation, cross-validation by multiple annotators, and expert final confirmation, which relies almost entirely on human labor and is extremely time-consuming and expensive. In contrast, the agent-augmented pipeline shifts the majority of the workload to AI agents, evolving into four new stages: prompt engineering, MLLM initial generation, multi-agent cross-validation, and expert final confirmation, with human intervention limited to only the first and last critical stages. The required intensity of human verification varies by data usage. For training sets where minor noise is tolerable, random sampling checks are sufficient; failed samples can be manually corrected or discarded. However, for test sets used to evaluate model performance and draw scientific conclusions, 100% full manual verification by domain experts is mandatory, as any errors can lead to misleading performance comparisons and invalid research findings.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但MLLM并非不可行。 在具有高度专业知识和模棱两可的视觉模式的RS领域,模型生成的说明不可避免地包含错误. 因此,对高质量的RS-VL数据集来说,人员即时质量控制仍然是不可或缺的。 传统的以人为中心的质量控制管道[220]由四个相继阶段组成:注释员培训,初步的人文注释,多位注释员的交叉验证,以及专家的最终确认,这几乎完全依赖于人的劳动,而且极其耗时和昂贵. 相比之下,代理加固管道将大部分工作量转移到AI代理,演变为四个新阶段:即即时工程,MLLM初始生成,多代理交叉验证,以及专家最终确认,人类干预仅限于第一个和最后一个关键阶段. 所需人力核查的强度因数据使用情况而异。 对于小噪声可以容忍的训练场,随机抽样检查就足够了;失败的样品可以手动纠正或丢弃. 然而,对于用于评价模型性能和得出科学结论的测试集,域专家100%的全手工核查是强制性的,因为任何错误都可能导致误导性性能比较和无效的研究结果.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the AI agent-driven paradigm still faces several limitations: current multi-agent systems struggle with highly specialized RS knowledge, their performance is highly dependent on prompt engineering quality, and standardized metrics for evaluating agent-generated reasoning data are lacking. Future research should focus on developing domain-specialized agents, exploring dynamic role assignment architectures, and establishing rigorous benchmarks for agent-constructed datasets, which will further accelerate the development of next-generation RS MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,AI代理驱动的范式仍然面临若干限制:目前的多代理系统与高度专业化的RS知识挣扎,其性能高度依赖即时工程质量,评价代理生成的推理数据的标准化衡量标准也缺乏. 未来的研究应侧重于开发域专门化的代理,探索动态角色分配架构,并为代理构建的数据集建立严格的基准,这将进一步加快下一代RS MLLMs的开发.

blocks.en: V-F Best Practices for Constructing High-Quality RS Vision-Language Dataset
blocks.zh: V-F级 建立高质量的RS远景-语言数据集的最佳做法

blocks.en: In RS vision-language research, redundant dataset construction and inconsistent quality standards waste valuable resources and hinder model development. As illustrated in Figure 15 , a vast amount of RS metadata is repeatedly repurposed to build RS vision-language datasets. Among them, the classic RS object detection dataset DOTA [ 38 ] has been repeatedly constructed as a vision-language dataset in 17 studies, resulting in significant redundancy. To address these pervasive challenges, this guide introduces a streamlined three-step workflow to help researchers efficiently construct high-quality datasets.
blocks.zh: 在塞族共和国的愿景语言研究中,冗余的数据集建设和质量标准不一致浪费了宝贵的资源,阻碍了模型的开发. 如图15所示,大量塞族共和国元数据被多次重新用于建立塞族共和国愿景语言数据集。 其中,经典的RS对象检测数据集DOTA[38]在17项研究中被反复构建为视觉语言数据集,导致大量冗余. 为了应对这些普遍存在的挑战,本指南引入了简化的三步工作流程,以帮助研究人员高效构建高质量的数据集.

blocks.en: TABLE VI: A Quick Lookup Table for Pre-construction Redundancy Check.
blocks.zh: 表六:施工前冗余检查快速查询表.

blocks.en: • Step 1: Pre-construction Redundancy Check: Before construction, consult Table VI to map base RS datasets to their existing vision-language extensions. If similar annotations exist, extend the current dataset or focus on underrepresented domains instead of rebuilding from scratch to reduce redundant workload. • Step 2: Task-Specific Semi-Automatic Annotation: Full manual annotation is costly and unscalable, so adopt a task-specific semi-automatic pipeline: use RS-fine-tuned VLMs for image-level captioning with human verification; combine pre-trained RS object detectors with region-specific caption generators for region-level descriptions; use template-based methods for factual QA and general MLLMs for reasoning QA, with mandatory human validation for all annotations. • Step 3: Rigorous Quality Control : Please follow the two pipelines shown in Figure 14 for quality management. All datasets should include a transparent public quality report recording construction details, standards and limitations.
blocks.zh: • 步骤1:施工前 冗余检查 : 在构建之前,请参考表六,将RS数据库数据集映射到现有的视觉语言扩展. 如果存在类似的说明,则扩展现有数据集或侧重于任职人数不足的领域,而不是从零开始重建,以减少多余的工作量。 • 步骤2:具体任务半自动 注释 : 完整的人工注释成本高昂且无法扩展,因此采用任务特定的半自动管道:使用RS-fine-turned VLM进行图像级字幕与人验证;将预训的RS天体探测器与区域特定标题生成器相结合,用于地区级描述;对事实QA和一般MLLMs采用基于模板的方法进行推理QA,所有注释都必须进行人验证. • 第3步:严格质量控制:请遵循图14所示两条管道进行质量管理。 所有数据集都应包括一份透明的公共质量报告,记录施工细节、标准和限制。

blocks.en: This standardized workflow minimizes redundancy, ensures dataset reliability, and accelerates RS vision-language model development. For users who find manual table consultation cumbersome, our GeoChef agent provides query services: after receiving your needs, it generates personalized dataset construction recommendations.
blocks.zh: 这种标准化的工作流程尽量减少冗余,确保数据集的可靠性,并加速RS视觉语言模型的开发. 对于发现手动表格咨询繁琐的用户,我们的GeoChef代理公司提供查询服务:在收到您的需要后,它生成个性化数据集构建建议.

blocks.en: VI Fine-tuning of RS Vision-Language Datasets
blocks.zh: 六. 调整RS远景-语言数据集

blocks.en: The third step towards becoming a GeoChef involves fine-tuning the model using the prepared vision-language data. This step can be likened to a chef cooking a dish, as it critically determines the final performance of the model. Although suitable ingredients have been carefully selected and preprocessed, improper control of the culinary process could undermine previous efforts. Thus, this phase is of great importance.
blocks.zh: 成为地理厨师的第三个步骤是利用已准备好的视觉语言数据对模型进行微调。 这个步骤可以比作厨师烹饪一种菜肴,因为它关键地决定了模型的最终性能. 虽然已经仔细挑选并预加工了合适的成分,但对烹饪过程的不当控制可能会破坏以前的努力. 因此,这一阶段非常重要。

blocks.en: Given that this paper primarily targets universities and small-to-medium-sized research institutions with limited computational resources, which often struggle to bear the high costs of training large models from scratch, it does not cover large-scale pre-training [ 226 , 227 ] . Instead, it focuses on deploying effective fine-tuning strategies based on pre-trained general-purpose MLLMs [ 228 , 229 ] . As an efficient transfer learning approach, fine-tuning can rapidly adapt large models to specific domains or tasks under constrained resources [ 230 , 231 ] . This chapter will first clarify the core differences and applicable scenarios between two technical paths: full-parameter fine-tuning (FPFT) [ 232 , 233 ] and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) [ 234 , 235 ] . Subsequently, it systematically introduces the basic methods of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) [ 236 , 237 ] and discusses the principles and advantages of reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) [ 238 , 239 ] techniques that have emerged in this year. By systematically reviewing different fine-tuning strategies, this chapter aims to guide researchers in flexibly selecting appropriate methods based on data characteristics, fully leveraging the potential of data to construct higher-performance MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 鉴于本文主要针对的是计算资源有限的大学和中小型研究机构,它们往往难以承担从零开始培训大型模型的高昂费用,因此它并不涵盖大规模预训[226,227]. 相反,它侧重于根据预先培训的通用MLLMs[228,229]部署有效的微调战略. 作为一种高效的转移学习方法,微调可以迅速使大型模型适应受限制资源下的特定领域或任务[230,231]. 本章将首先澄清两个技术路径之间的核心差异和适用情景:全参数微调[FPFT][232,233]和参数效率微调[234,235]. 随后,它系统地引入了监督微调的基本方法[236,237],并讨论了今年出现的强化微调[238,239]技术的原则和优点. 本章通过系统地审查不同的微调战略,旨在指导研究人员根据数据特征灵活选择适当的方法,充分利用数据的潜力来构建性能更高的MLLM.

blocks.en: VI-A FPFT v.s. PEFT
blocks.zh: VI-A FPFT诉PEFT案

blocks.en: FPFT represents the most classical approach to model adaptation. Its core principle involves unlocking all parameters of a pre-trained model and performing end-to-end training updates on a task-specific dataset [ 240 ] . This method aims to meticulously adjust the weights of each layer according to the requirements of the new task, thereby maximizing the model’s potential to achieve optimal task-specific performance. In the domain of RS, VHM [ 148 ] performed FPFT on 16 NVIDIA A100-80G GPUs, while EarthDial [ 103 ] employed 8 identical GPUs for its training. However, this comprehensive adjustment comes at a significant cost in computational resources and time, making it particularly unsuitable for environments with limited resources, such as universities and small-to-medium-sized research institutions. Furthermore, each model fine-tuned in this manner requires storing a complete parameter copy, leading to substantial storage overhead. It also tends to be prone to overfitting when the dataset is small.
blocks.zh: FPFT代表了最经典的模型适应方法. 其核心原则是解锁预训模型的所有参数,并就特定任务数据集进行端到端培训更新[240]. 这种方法旨在根据新任务的要求仔细调整每层的权重,从而最大限度地发挥模型的潜力,实现针对具体任务的最佳性能. 在RS领域,VHM [148]在16架NVIDIA A100-80G GPU上执行FPFT,而EarthDial [103]则使用8架相同的GPU进行训练. 然而,这种全面调整在计算资源和时间方面付出了很大代价,因此特别不适合资源有限的环境,如大学和中小型研究机构。 此外,以这种方式进行微调的每个模型都需要存储完整的参数副本,从而导致大量存储间接费用。 当数据集较小时,它也往往容易过于适应.

blocks.en:
To address the challenges above, PEFT techniques have emerged. The core idea is to keep the main parameters of the pre-trained model fixed, introducing and training only a minimal adapter to learn task-specific knowledge. Among various PEFT techniques, LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) [ 241 ] stands out as one of the most mainstream and practical methods.
For example, GeoChat [ 33 ] freezes the visual encoder and projection layer, fine-tuning only the LLM with LoRA to inject RS knowledge into LLaVA. SkyEyeGPT [ 212 ] freezes the visual encoder and fine-tunes both the LLM and projection layer with LoRA. RS-LLaVA [ 242 ] , by contrast, fine-tunes all three components simultaneously with LoRA. Some methods combine both approaches, such as LHRS-Bot [ 112 ] which uses FPFT for connection layers and LoRA for the LLM.
blocks.zh:
为了应对上述挑战,PEFT技术出现了. 其核心思想是将预训模式的主要参数固定下来,只引进和培训一个最低限度的适配器来学习任务特定的知识. 在各种PEFT技术中,LORA(Low-Rank adaptation)[241]是最主流和实用的方法之一。
例如GeoChat [33] 冻结了视觉编码器和投影层,只微调LLM与LORA,将RS知识注入LLaVA. SkyEyeGPT [212] 冻结了视觉编码器,并用LORA对LLM和投影层进行微调. RS-LLAVA [242] 相比之下,将所有三个组件与LORA同时进行微调. 一些方法结合了这两种方法,例如LHRS-Bot[112]将FPFT用于连接层,而LLM则使用LORA.

blocks.en: FPFT and PEFT offer complementary strengths. FPFT is preferred for peak-performance tasks, GPU-rich environments, large domain shifts, and data-abundant scenarios. PEFT, by contrast, is optimal for resource-limited settings, rapid deployment, multi-task learning, and data-scarce applications where overfitting is a major concern [ 243 , 244 , 245 ] .
blocks.zh: FPFT和PEFT提供互补优势. FPFT在峰值性能任务,GPU丰富的环境,大型域位移,以及数据丰富的假想中更受青睐. 相比之下,PEFT对于资源有限的设置、快速部署、多任务学习和数据稀缺应用程序来说,是最佳的,因为这些应用程序过于匹配是一个主要关切问题[243、244、245]。

blocks.en: VI-B SFT v.s. RFT
blocks.zh: VI-B SFT诉RFT案

blocks.en: SFT is fundamentally an imitative learning paradigm [ 246 , 247 ] . Its core mechanism involves guiding models to learn task-specific answer distributions by minimizing the loss between predictions and ground-truth labels using large-scale high-quality input-output annotated data, analogous to students learning from examples. In RS applications, the FPFT and PEFT methods, which were introduced earlier, all fall under the category of SFT. It excels in simple implementation, stable training, low computational cost, rapid achievement of excellent stable performance on well-defined tasks with sufficient high-quality data, and strong output style controllability. Its main limitations include heavy reliance on costly annotated data, confinement to training data distributions, lack of active innovation, poor generalization to dynamically changing or open-ended tasks, and significant overfitting risks.
blocks.zh: SFT基本上是一个模仿性的学习范式[246,247]. 其核心机制涉及指导模型,通过使用大规模高质量的输入输出附加说明的数据,将预测和地面真实标签之间的损失减少到最低程度,从而学习特定任务的答案分布,类似于学生从实例中学习。 在RS应用中,FPFT和PEFT两种方法较早推出,均属于SFT类. 它在简单实施、稳定培训、低计算成本、在有充足高质量数据的明确任务上迅速取得出色的稳定业绩以及强大的产出样式可控性方面表现突出。 其主要局限包括严重依赖费用高昂的附加说明的数据、限制培训数据分发、缺乏积极创新、对动态变化或开放式任务的概括性差、以及风险严重过度。

blocks.en: RFT is an advanced fine-tuning technique built on SFT [ 248 ] . It introduces a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that uses reward signals—rather than fixed input-output annotations—to drive model optimization. Recent RS research shows substantial gains from RFT. The Geo-R1 [ 249 ] paradigm enforces a ”reason first, then act” process for few-shot geospatial referring expression understanding, where the model first generates explicit reasoning chains before localizing target objects—consistently and substantially outperforming SFT baselines across three few-shot benchmarks while demonstrating strong cross-dataset generalization. DVGBench employs RFT to train an implicit-to-explicit reasoning mechanism for UAV RS imagery, significantly enhancing visual reasoning grounding capabilities. RFT’s core mechanism is trial-and-error learning: a preset reward function quantifies how well the model output meets task objectives, and RL algorithms like policy gradients iteratively update the model to maximize rewards. RFT overcomes the annotation limitations of SFT, improving output quality, consistency, task alignment, generalization, and reliability. However, it is ineffective for samples that are always wrong or always correct; its main benefit is on near-decision-boundary samples that are sometimes correct, sometimes not. Therefore, selecting such samples as training data maximizes RFT’s optimization gains.
blocks.zh: RFT是一种基于SFT[248]的高级微调技术. 它引入了一个强化学习(RL)框架,使用奖励信号——而不是固定输入输出说明——来驱动模型优化。 斯普斯卡共和国最近的研究表明,RFT大有收获。 Geo-R1[249]范式执行一个“先理性,然后行动”程序,用于几发地理空间参考表达理解,即该模型首先产生明确的推理链,然后将目标物体定位——在三个几发基准上一致和实质性地超过SFT基线,同时显示强有力的跨数据集通用。 DVGBench公司使用RFT来培训无人驾驶飞行器RS图像的隐含至显性推理机制,大大提升了视觉推理定位能力. RFT的核心机制是尝试和过度学习:一种预设的奖励函数将模型输出达到任务目标的程度量化,RL算法如政策梯度的迭代更新模型以最大化奖励. RFT克服了SFT的注释限制,提高了产出质量,一致性,任务一致,通俗化,可靠性. 然而,对于总是错误或总是正确的样品来说,这是无效的;其主要好处在于近决定边界样品有时是正确的,有时是不正确的。 因此,选取培训数据等样本可以最大限度地提高RFT的优化效益。

blocks.en: In practical application scenarios, SFT and RFT are not opposing optimization options but form a progressive relationship of basic laying and advanced improvement in the large model iteration process. For most large model deployment scenarios, it is recommended to first complete SFT training using high-quality annotated data to quickly drive the model to adapt to the core needs of the task. GeoZero [ 250 ] employs a two-stage fine-tuning strategy: first SFT, then RFT. It first applies SFT to simple problems to build a solid foundation for the model, and then uses RFT on challenging problems to further unlock the model’s potential.
blocks.zh: 在实际应用情景中,SFT和RFT并不反对优化选项,而是在大型模型迭代过程中形成基本铺设和先进改进的渐进关系. 对于大多数大型模型部署方案,建议首先使用高质量的附加说明的数据完成SFT培训,以快速推动模型适应任务的核心需求. GeoZero [250]采用两级微调策略:先是SFT,后是RFT. 它首先将SFT应用于简单的问题,为模型建立坚实的基础,然后利用RFT来挑战性的问题进一步释放模型的潜力.

blocks.en: However, if it is necessary to carry out research related to Chain-of-Thought (CoT) [ 181 ] , building on SFT is an inevitable path. Taking exploration research on RS CoT as an example, the general technical route usually first uses a large amount of high-quality CoT data to perform SFT, enabling the model to master basic question-answering capabilities and the ability to output thinking processes, thus becoming a qualified model with basic task adaptability. On this basis, the RFT mechanism is introduced to further optimize the model’s answer quality and CoT logic through a carefully designed reward function [ 251 ] . Nevertheless, the lack of high-quality CoT-annotated data in the RS domain poses a significant challenge, as directly employing data without CoT annotations for SFT tends to diminish the MLLM’s ability to produce coherent reasoning chains [ 252 ] . To mitigate this issue, two primary strategies have been explored: one leverages advanced closed-source models to automatically generate CoT-annotated SFT samples, while the other applies RFT directly to general-purpose MLLMs, bypassing domain-specific SFT entirely [ 253 ] . SocraticAgent [ 163 ] developed a self-play system to generate high-quality CoT-annotated SFT data. The system comprises two AI MLLMs: the Reasoner and the Perceiver, which produce training data by simulating Socratic dialogues. DroneVG-R1 [ 254 ] did not perform SFT and directly used manually annotated implicit-to-explicit CoT for RFT.
blocks.zh: 然而,如果有必要进行与 " 思考链 " (CoT)[181]有关的研究,则在SFT基础上发展是不可避免的途径。 以RS CoT的探索研究为例,一般技术路线通常首先使用大量高质量的CoT数据来完成SFT,使模型能够掌握基本的问答能力和输出思维过程的能力,从而成为具有基本任务适应性的合格模型. 在此基础上,采用了RFT机制,通过精心设计的奖励功能[251],进一步优化模型的答题质量和CoT逻辑. 尽管如此,在RS域中缺乏高质量的CoT附加说明的数据构成重大挑战,因为直接使用没有SFT的CoT说明的数据往往会削弱MLLM制作连贯推理链的能力[252]. 为了缓解这个问题,探索了两种主要战略:一种是利用先进的闭源模型自动生成CoT附加说明的SFT样本,另一种是直接将RFT应用于通用的MLLMs,绕过特定域的SFT完全[253]. Socratic Agent [163] 开发了自玩系统,生成高质量的CoT附加说明的SFT数据. 该系统包括两个AI MLLM:Reasoner和Perceiver,它们通过模拟Socratic对话生成培训数据. DroneVG-R1 [254]没有执行SFT,直接使用手动附加说明的暗对显式CoT用于RFT.

blocks.en: VII Evaluation of RS MLLMs
blocks.zh: 七、结 论 评价RS MLLMs

blocks.en: Model evaluation serves as the final step in the GeoChef pipeline, marking both the completion of a new iterative cycle and the commencement of a new one. Just as the quality of culinary dishes must be judged by customer feedback, the performance of a trained model must be evaluated against standardized benchmarks. Based on the evaluation results, researchers can refine data selection strategies, data preprocessing procedures, and fine-tuning approaches, thereby continuously improving the model—much like honing one’s culinary skills. We summarize the most common public benchmarks and their corresponding evaluation metrics for 4 RS vision-language tasks in Tables VII , VIII , IX , and X , which can serve as a reference for newcomers to the field. In addition to utilizing existing benchmarks, researchers may also construct specialized benchmarks to verify the superiority of their proposed methods for specific problems under fair testing conditions.
blocks.zh: 模型评价是GeoChef管道的最后一步,标志着新的迭代周期的完成和新的周期的开始。 正如烹饪菜的质量必须根据顾客的反馈来判断一样,必须对照标准化的基准来评价训练有素的型号的表现。 根据评价结果,研究人员可以完善数据选择战略、数据预处理程序和微调方法,从而不断改进模型——就像磨练自己的烹饪技能。 我们总结表七、八、九和十中4个塞尔维亚语远景语言任务的最常见的公共基准及其相应的评价指标,这些基准和指标可作为新到外地工作的参考。 除了利用现有的基准外,研究人员还可以制定专门的基准,以核实他们在公平测试条件下针对具体问题的拟议方法的优越性。

blocks.en: TABLE VII: Comparison of mainstream RS MLLMs on 3 RS image captioning benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表七:关于3个RS图像字幕基准的主流RS MLLMs的比较.

blocks.en: VII-A Evaluation on RS Image Captioning Tasks
blocks.zh: RS图像说明任务评价

blocks.en: To ensure a reasonable and well-grounded evaluation, we select five complementary metrics tailored to the multi-dimensional requirements of RS image captioning (lexical accuracy, semantic fidelity, fluency, and informational richness). BLEU-4 [ 256 ] measures 4-gram precision to assess domain terminology accuracy and syntactic correctness, while METEOR [ 257 ] compensates for its limitations by emphasizing semantic equivalence and aligning with human judgments. ROUGE-1 (unigram coverage) and ROUGE-L (longest common subsequence) [ 258 ] evaluate the capture of key geographic features and spatial coherence, respectively. CIDEr [ 259 ] , designed specifically for image captioning, uses TF-IDF weighting to highlight informational salience by prioritizing rare, discriminative terms.
blocks.zh: 为了确保合理和有依据的评价,我们选择了五个补充性衡量标准,以适应塞族共和国图像标题的多维要求(精确度、语义忠诚度、流利度和信息丰富度)。 BLEU-4 [256]度量精度为4克,用于评估域名术语的准确性和合成正确性,而METEOR [257]则通过强调语义等同,与人类判断一致来弥补其局限性. ROUGE-1(单格覆盖)和ROUGE-L(最长的常见子序列)[258]分别评价关键地理特征的捕捉和空间一致性. CIDEr [259],专为图像标题设计,使用TF-IDF加权法,通过优先排序稀有,歧视性的术语来突出信息亮点.

blocks.en: Table VII reveals a complex and nuanced competitive landscape within the field of RS image captioning. The GeoZero [ 250 ] model emerges as a particularly notable contender. It demonstrates performance approaching the performance ceiling on the UCM-Captions [ 136 ] dataset, exemplified by its remarkably high METEOR score of 83.75. This indicates an exceptional capability in generating fluent descriptions with near-perfect semantic alignment, suggesting a powerful fitting ability in specific, well-structured scenarios. However, a clear specialization bias is observed across the models. The RS-CapRet [ 255 ] model achieves a standout CIDEr score of 250.20 on the most challenging RSICD [ 127 ] dataset, significantly surpassing all other models. This result highlights its unique advantage in producing highly informative and salient captions. Yet, this superiority is not entirely sustained on the Sydney dataset [ 136 ] , implying potential boundaries to its generalizability.
blocks.zh: 表七显示塞族共和国图像标题领域的复杂和细微的竞争环境。 GeoZero[250]模型作为特别引人注目的竞争者出现。 它显示业绩接近UCM-Captions [136]数据集的性能上限,其显著高的METEOR得分83.75就是例证. 这表明,在制作流利的描述方面,有一种超乎寻常的能力,其语义近乎完美,这表明在具体、结构完善的情景中,有一种强大的适应能力。 然而,在整个模型中都观察到明显的专业化偏差。 RS-CapRet [255]模型在最具挑战性的RSCD [127]数据集上实现了250.20的立体CIDER分数,大大超过了所有其他模型. 这一成果突出了它在制作内容丰富和突出的字幕方面的独特优势。 然而,这种优越性在悉尼数据集[136]上并不完全维持,意味着其通俗性的潜在界限.

blocks.en: In summary, no single model establishes absolute dominance across all datasets and evaluation metrics, underscoring the current absence of a universally superior solution. Model performance is highly dependent on the alignment between its training objectives and the distribution of the test data. The future competitive focus will likely center on developing a general-purpose model that exhibits balanced and robust capabilities across diverse and challenging real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 总之,没有一个单一模式确定所有数据集和评价衡量尺度的绝对支配地位,这突出表明目前缺乏一个普遍优越的解决办法。 模型性能高度依赖其培训目标与测试数据分布的一致. 未来的竞争重点可能集中在开发一个通用模式,在各种具有挑战性的现实世界情景中表现出平衡和强大的能力。

blocks.en: VII-B Evaluation on RS VQA Tasks
blocks.zh: 七-B 评价RS VQA任务

blocks.en: In RS VQA tasks, accuracy [ 260 ] is generally regarded as the primary evaluation metric. For counting-oriented questions or regression-based tasks, regression metrics such as mean absolute error (MAE) [ 261 ] are commonly adopted to quantify prediction errors. In this survey, we uniformly use Overall Accuracy (OA) [ 32 ] as the core quantitative evaluation metric across all four RS VQA benchmarks, as it has become the de facto standard in the RS vision-language community. Formally, the OA metric is defined as the percentage of test samples where the model’s predicted answer is completely consistent with the human-annotated ground truth.
blocks.zh: 在RS VQA任务中,准确性[260]一般被认为是主要评价指标. 对于面向计数的问题或基于回归的任务,通常采用平均绝对误差(MAE)[261]等回归度量法来量化预测误差. 在这项调查中,我们统一使用总体准确性[32]作为所有四个塞族共和国自愿定性评估基准的核心定量评价衡量标准,因为它已成为塞族共和国愿景语社区事实上的标准。 在形式上,OA度量法被定义为模型的预测答案与人类附加说明的地面真理完全一致的测试样本的百分比.

blocks.en: TABLE VIII: Comparison of mainstream RS MLLMs on 4 RS VQA benchmarks. Among them, XLRS-Bench and LRS-VQA belong to the ultra-high-resolution dataset.
blocks.zh: 表八:关于4个RS VQA基准的主流RS MLLMs的比较. 其中,XLRS-Bench和LRS-VQA属于超高分辨率数据集.

blocks.en: As shown in Table VIII , leading models have achieved scores approaching or exceeding 90 on the conventional RSVQA-LR and HR datasets [ 32 ] , indicating that the VQA task for RS images at standard resolutions is nearing maturity. However, a drastic performance decline is observed on the ultra-high-resolution benchmarks, XLRS-Bench [ 150 ] and LRS-VQA [ 171 ] , where most reported scores fall within the 20–50 range. This significant gap highlights the fundamental challenges posed by ultra-high-resolution imagery, including perceiving fine-grained visual patterns, filtering critical information from massive pixel data, and comprehending complex long-range spatial relationships. These challenges likely push the capabilities of existing mainstream model architectures to their limits.
blocks.zh: 如表八所示,主要模型在常规的RSVQA-LR和HR数据集上取得了接近或超过90的分数[32],表明标准分辨率下RS图像的VQA任务已接近成熟. 然而,在超高分辨率基准(XLRS-Bench [150])和LRS-VQA [171])上观察到业绩急剧下降,大多数报告得分都在20至50个范围内。 这一重大差距突出了超高分辨率图像构成的基本挑战,包括透视精细的视觉模式,从大规模像素数据中过滤关键信息,以及理解复杂的远程空间关系。 这些挑战可能将现有主流模式架构的能力推向极限。

blocks.en: Furthermore, model development exhibits a clear trend toward specialization. One group of models aims to achieve state-of-the-art performance on specific tasks, serving as domain-specific experts. For instance, RS-LLaVA [ 242 ] achieves the highest score on RSVQA-LR, GeoZero [ 250 ] leads by a significant margin on XLRS-Bench, and ZoomSearch [ 264 ] performs best on LRS-VQA.
blocks.zh: 此外,模式发展显示出专业化的明显趋势。 一组模型旨在完成特定任务的最新业绩,担任特定领域专家。 例如,RS-LLAVA[242]在RSVQA-LR上取得最高分,GeoZero[250]在XLRS-Bench上以显著的比分领先,ZoomSearch[264]在LRS-VQA上表现最好.

blocks.en: Notably, GeoZero presents a promising exception. It maintains high competitiveness on the traditional high-resolution task RSVQA-HR while achieving a commanding lead on the ultra-high-resolution XLRS-Bench. This outcome suggests that its technical approach may possess superior generalization and robustness in handling visual information across different scales and complexities, offering valuable insights for developing next-generation, more powerful and general RS vision-language models.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,GeoZero是一个很有希望的例外。 它在传统的高分辨率任务RSVQA-HR上保持高竞争力,同时在超高分辨率XLRS-Bench上取得指挥领先. 这一结果表明,其技术方法在处理不同规模和复杂程度的视觉信息方面可能具有优越的概括性和强健性,为开发下一代、更强大和更普遍的塞族共和国视觉语言模型提供了宝贵的见解。

blocks.en: VII-C Evaluation on RS VG Tasks
blocks.zh: 七-C 对RS VG任务的评价

blocks.en: TABLE IX: Comparison of mainstream RS MLLMs on 4 RS region-level VG benchmarks. Among them, AVVG belongs to the high-resolution dataset.
blocks.zh: 表格 九:在4个塞族共和国区域一级VG基准上比较主流的RS MLLMs. 其中,AVVG属于高分辨率数据集.

blocks.en: TABLE X: Comparison of mainstream RS MLLMs on 2 RS pixel-level VG benchmarks. Among them, EarthReason belongs to the dataset of reasoning segmentation.
blocks.zh: 表十:2 RS像素级VG基准上主流RS MLLMs的比较. 其中EarthReason属于推理分解的数据集.

blocks.en: For RS VG tasks, different metrics are adopted based on the number of target objects. Specifically, IoU@0.5 accuracy [ 266 ] is used for single-object referring grounding to assess the localization accuracy of the target object. For multi-object referring grounding, AP@50 [ 38 ] is employed to comprehensively evaluate the model’s grounding performance. It should be noted that a higher IoU threshold imposes stricter requirements on grounding precision, and IoU@0.5 is widely recognized as the standard threshold in the field of RS VG.
blocks.zh: 对于RS VG任务,根据目标对象的数量采用不同的度量衡. 具体来说,IoU@0.5精度[266]用于单对象的参考地面,以评估目标对象的定位精度. 对于多对象定位,AP@50[38]被用来全面评价模型的定位性能。 应当指出,更高的IoU阈值对定位精度提出了更严格的要求,IoU@0.5被广泛认为是RS VG领域的标准阈值.

blocks.en: Table IX reveals a significant performance gap between advanced and early MLLMs in region-level VG. Leading models, such as RSCoVLM [ 208 ] and GeoZero [ 250 ] , score above 50 points across datasets, including RSVG [ 191 ] , DIOR-RSVG [ 188 ] , and VRSBench [ 149 ] , demonstrating strong geolocation capabilities. In contrast, earlier models, such as GeoChat [ 33 ] and LHRS-Bot [ 112 ] , generally score below 25 points, with performance on the high-resolution AVVG dataset [ 187 ] approaching zero. This gap highlights rapid technological progress in the field. The AVVG dataset serves as a challenging benchmark, where all models perform significantly worse; even the top model, RSCoVLM, achieves only 29.40 points.
blocks.zh: 表九显示,在区域级别VG中,高级和早期的MLLM之间有显著的性能差距。 主要模型,如RSCoVLM [208]和GeoZero [250],在数据集中得分超过50分,包括RSVG [191],DIOR-RSVG [188],以及VRS Bench [149],显示出强大的地理定位能力. 相比之下,早期的模型,如GeoChat [33] 和LHRS-Bot [112],一般得分低于25分,在高分辨率AVVG数据集上的表现[187]接近零. 这一差距突出了该领域的快速技术进步。 AVVG数据集作为一个具有挑战性的基准,所有模型的性能都大不如前;甚至顶级模型RSCoVLM也只达到29.40分.

blocks.en: Table X further illustrates a trend of capability differentiation in pixel-level RS MLLMs, marked by a competition between basic segmentation accuracy and advanced reasoning. UniGeoSeg [ 196 ] excels in both tasks, particularly on the challenging EarthReason dataset [ 202 ] , demonstrating strong generalization and reasoning abilities for complex instructions that involve geographical knowledge. It can be considered an all-round performer. Conversely, GeoPixel [ 154 ] leads in traditional segmentation on the RRSIS-D [ 201 ] dataset, particularly in the precise localization metric P@0.5; however, its performance declines on the EarthReason task. This suggests that models optimized for traditional segmentation may not be designed for the high-level semantic understanding required by reasoning-intensive tasks. Additionally, SegEarth shows minimal change in basic segmentation metrics from version R1 to R2 [ 169 ] , but a clear improvement in reasoning, indicating a focused effort on enhancing reasoning capabilities, which aligns with the field’s move toward a deeper geographical understanding.
blocks.zh: 图表 X进一步说明了像素级的RS MLLMs的能力差异趋势,其标志是基本分解精度与高级推理之间的竞争. UniGeoSeg [196]在这两项任务中都表现突出,特别是在具有挑战性的地球Reason数据集[202]方面,显示出对涉及地理知识的复杂指令的强烈概括和推理能力. 可以认为是全方位的表演者. 反之,GeoPixel [154]在RRSIS-D [201]数据集的传统分化中领先,特别是在精确本地化度度量P@0.5;然而,它在EarthReason任务上的性能下降. 这表明,为传统分化而优化的模型可能不是为了推理密集型任务所要求的高级语义理解而设计的. 此外,SegEarth显示R1版至R2[169]版的基本分化度量变化很小,但推理明显改善,表明集中力量加强推理能力,这与实地向更深入的地理理解迈进是一致的。

blocks.en:
In summary, the two tables above clearly outline a watershed in the current development of RS
MLLMs: models are no longer solely pursuing accurate vision but are also diverging into a new track of deep reasoning.
blocks.zh:
简言之,上两个表格明确概述了斯普斯卡共和国当前发展的分水岭。
MLLMs:模型不再仅仅追求准确的愿景,而是在深入推理的新轨道上存在分歧。

blocks.en: VII-D Limitations of Current Evaluation
blocks.zh: 现行评价的局限性

blocks.en: The rapid proliferation of RS MLLMs has exposed fundamental flaws in existing evaluation paradigms, where inflated performance metrics often bear little relation to a model’s true generalization ability. A core and pervasive issue is information leakage, which undermines the validity of benchmark comparisons and misguides research directions. We first systematically categorize three distinct yet interconnected information leakage pathways prevalent in RS-VLM benchmarks:
blocks.zh: RS MLLMs的迅速扩散暴露了现有评价范式中的根本缺陷,其中夸大的业绩衡量标准往往与模型真正的概括性能力没有什么关系。 一个核心和普遍的问题是信息泄漏,它损害了基准比较的有效性,并误导了研究方向。 我们首先系统地将RS-VLM基准中普遍存在的三种不同但相互关联的信息泄漏途径分类:

blocks.en: • Pre-training leakage has become particularly prominent as large-scale pre-trained VLMs [ 24 , 122 ] have become a standard paradigm. Current general-domain pre-training corpora such as CLIP [ 2 ] incorporate billions of RS images and text descriptions [ 21 ] , leading downstream task evaluation to essentially become a seen-answer test that severely overestimates the model’s zero-shot and few-shot performance. However, the risk of pre-training leakage is often overlooked in the era of large models. • Metadata leakage occurs because the visual-language datasets used for training and testing are constructed based on the same RS meta-datasets. As shown in Fig. 15 , as many as 17 RS visual-language datasets have been built on DOTA [ 38 ] , resulting in severe metadata leakage risks among these datasets. The presence of identical images in the test and training sets can still inflate evaluation accuracy, even if the text annotations are not fully consistent. • Reasoning grounding leakage arises when reasoning referring texts are directly annotated on the basis of original referring expressions. With the development of visual reasoning, an increasing number of reasoning grounding datasets [ 202 , 169 , 197 , 254 ] have emerged. Some of these datasets directly generate reasoning texts from existing VG datasets without changing the referred objects, allowing MLLMs fine-tuned on non-reasoning VG datasets to blindly predict the answers to reasoning grounding tasks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 培训前的渗漏已经变得特别突出,因为大规模培训前的VLM[24,122]已经成为标准范式. 目前通用域前训练公司如CLIP[2]包含数十亿RS图像和文本描述[21],导致下游任务评价基本成为目击答测试,严重高估了模型的零射和少射性能. 然而,在大型模型时代,培训前渗漏的风险往往被忽视。 • 元数据渗漏,因为用于培训和测试的视觉语言数据集是根据相同的RS元数据集构建的。 如图15所示,在DOTA[38]上建有多达17个RS视觉语言数据集,导致这些数据集存在严重的元数据泄露风险. 测试集和培训集中存在相同的图像,即使文字说明不完全一致,仍然可以提高评价的准确性. • 支助 依据原始提法直接说明提及案文的理由便会产生渗漏。 随着视觉推理的发展,出现了越来越多的推理定位数据集[202,169,197,254]. 其中一些数据集直接从现有的VG数据集中生成推理文本,而不改变被引用的对象,使得在非理性VG数据集上微调的MLLMs可以盲目预测推理定位任务的答案.

blocks.en: Beyond the three types of information leakage discussed previously, discrepancies in evaluation implementation details can also undermine the impartiality of benchmarking. In what follows, we elaborate on three evaluation criteria that are frequently neglected:
blocks.zh: 除了先前讨论的三类信息泄漏之外,评价执行细节的差异也可能损害基准的公正性。 在下文中,我们阐述了三个经常被忽视的评价标准:

blocks.en: • Prompting Consistency Criteria : For benchmark-focused papers, evaluate representative MLLMs’ zero-shot performance on the proposed benchmark [ 150 ] . Ensure task prompts are consistent with the original literature, as prompt variations significantly affect task performance – e.g., Qwen2.5-VL’s support for absolute and 1000 [ 86 ] – scaled normalized coordinates causes large precision gaps in VG. • Answer Extraction Criteria : For VQA tasks with stringent output format constraints, final answers can be extracted via regular expression matching or constrained through multi-turn dialogue to enforce standardized output formats [ 155 ] . Uniform answer extraction strategies must be applied across all evaluated models to ensure consistent and comparable results. • SFT Data Consistency Criteria : For fine-tuning studies [ 250 , 249 ] , ensure all baseline MLLMs are fine-tuned on the same training dataset for fair comparison. Test sets often align with training data, so fine-tuned models gain advantages that may obscure architectural or strategy contributions, a detail sometimes overlooked to highlight method superiority.
blocks.zh: · 迅速一致性标准:对于以基准为重点的文件,评价具有代表性的MLLMs在拟议基准上的零射效绩[150]。 确保任务提示与原始文献一致,因为即时变化会显著影响任务性能——例如,Quen2.5-VL对绝对的支持和1000[86]的缩放的正态坐标在VG中造成了很大的精度差距. · 回答提取标准:对于输出格式有严格限制的VQA任务,最终答案可以通过正则表达式匹配来提取,或者通过多回合对话来强制实施标准化输出格式[155]. 在所有评价模式中必须采用统一答案提取战略,以确保取得一致和可比较的结果。 • SFT 数据一致性标准:对于微调研究[250,249],确保所有基线的MLLM在同一个培训数据集上进行微调,以便进行公平比较. 测试集往往与培训数据一致,因此微调模型获得的优势可能模糊建筑或战略贡献,这一细节有时被忽略,以突出方法优势.

blocks.en: VII-E Future Direction of Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 七-E 未来基准方向

blocks.en: At this stage, RS vision-language benchmarks have gradually evolved from single-temporal and single-modal to multi-temporal and multi-modal settings [ 183 ] , from image chips to large-scale RS scenes [ 150 ] , and from shallow semantic matching to deep cognitive reasoning [ 254 ] .
blocks.zh: 在现阶段,RS视觉语言基准从单时段和单模式逐渐演化为多时段和多模式设置[183],从图像芯片到大规模RS场景[150],从浅语义匹配到深度认知推理[254].

blocks.en:
However, two promising trends can be foreseen in future benchmark development. First, benchmarks are shifting from general capability evaluation to domain specialization. They are moving beyond generic scene understanding toward professional scenarios such as disaster response [ 88 ] , agricultural monitoring [ 156 ] , and photogrammetry [ 155 ] , enabling fine-grained assessment of domain semantics, and expert knowledge alignment.
Second, evaluation paradigms are transitioning from model-centric testing to agent-oriented assessment [ 267 ] , driven by the explosive rise and widespread adoption of AI agent technologies. Unlike standalone large models that are mostly constrained to static reasoning within fixed knowledge boundaries, AI agents can execute far more complex, multi-step real-world tasks through flexible tool invocation and modular collaborative workflows [ 177 ] .
blocks.zh:
然而,在未来制定基准时可以预见到两个有希望的趋势。 首先,基准正在从一般能力评价转向领域专业化。 它们超越了一般的场景理解,转向专业情景,如救灾[88]、农业监测[156]和摄影测量[155],从而能够对域语义进行精细评估,以及使专家知识一致。
第二,评价范式正在从以模型为中心的测试过渡到以剂为导向的评估[267],由爆炸性上升和AI剂技术的广泛采用所驱动. 与主要受固定知识边界内静态推理制约的独立的大型模型不同,AI代理可以通过灵活的工具引用和模块化协作工作流程执行远为复杂,多步骤的现实世界任务[177].

blocks.en: VIII Challenges and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 八. 挑战和未来方向

blocks.en: VIII-A Reasoning Tasks
blocks.zh: 八-A 合理任务

blocks.en: The research focus of RS vision-language models is shifting from fundamental perception tasks to more challenging, complex reasoning tasks. This transition stems from a core challenge: conventional tasks such as object detection [ 268 ] and semantic segmentation [ 269 ] can often be effectively accomplished without leveraging the deep comprehension and reasoning capabilities of ML’LMs, making it difficult to fully exploit the advantages of MLLMs. To break through this bottleneck, researchers have begun constructing a series of new benchmark datasets that require deep intent understanding and logical reasoning, aiming to evaluate and promote model performance at higher cognitive levels. These emerging reasoning tasks primarily present challenges across several dimensions. Implicit VG [ 202 ] requires models to understand instructions that imply specific attributes or functional relationships rather than directly referring to object appearance. Temporal reasoning [ 183 ] demands that models analyze multi-temporal RS images to understand dynamic processes such as urban expansion and disaster evolution. Relational reasoning [ 139 ] challenges models to comprehend intricate interactive relationships among multiple ground objects within an image. 3D spatial reasoning [ 215 ] elevates the challenge from the two-dimensional image plane to the three-dimensional spatial level, requiring an understanding of object height, volume, and 3D spatial relationships. Multimodal mathematical reasoning [ 155 ] extends the challenge to integrating mathematical logic and visual information, testing the model’s ability to transform visual information into mathematical models and perform calculations. In summary, the frontier challenges in RS vision-language data for reasoning tasks are centered on advancing models beyond basic seeing and recognizing towards deeper cognitive capabilities. These challenges are guiding RS vision-language research towards more profound and general spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh: RS视觉语言模型的研究重点正在从基本感知任务转向更具挑战性的复杂推理任务. 这种转变源于一个核心挑战:通常可以有效地完成诸如物体探测[268]和语义分解[269]等常规任务,而不利用MLL的深刻理解和推理能力,从而难以充分利用MLLMs的优势. 为了突破这个瓶颈,研究人员已经开始构建一系列新的基准数据集,这些数据集需要深刻的意向理解和逻辑推理,目的是在更高的认知水平上评价和促进模型性能. 这些新出现的推理任务主要在几个方面提出了挑战。 隐含VG[202]要求模型理解暗示特定属性或功能关系的指示,而不是直接提及对象外观. 时间推理[183]要求模型分析多时段的RS图像,以了解城市扩张和灾害演化等动态过程. 关系推理[139]挑战模型理解图像内多个地面物体之间错综复杂的互动关系. 3D空间推理[215]将挑战从二维图像平面提升到三维空间水平,需要了解物体高度,体积,和3D空间关系. 多式联运数学推理[155]将挑战扩展到将数学逻辑和视觉信息整合,测试模型将视觉信息转化为数学模型和进行计算的能力. 简言之,塞族共和国用于推理任务的视觉语言数据的前沿挑战集中在推进模型,使其超越基本视觉和认知能力。 这些挑战正在指导塞族共和国的愿景语言研究,以获得更深刻和更普遍的空间情报。

blocks.en: VIII-B Ultra-High-Resolution RS Imagery
blocks.zh: VIII-B 超高分辨率 RS 图像

blocks.en: The processing of very large-scale RS imagery poses a systemic challenge for current RS MLLMs, spanning the dimensions of data, algorithms, and computational resources. From a data foundation perspective, the cost of constructing high-quality benchmarking and training datasets remains prohibitively high. Such imagery requires fine-grained annotation reliant on specialized RS domain knowledge. While purely manual annotation can ensure quality, it suffers from efficiency limitations. For instance, the development of benchmarks like XLRS-Bench [ 150 ] necessitates annotating dozens of tasks for a single image; this extremely time-consuming nature directly constrains the accumulation of large-scale, high-quality, contextually rich data. Through manual annotation of 4K UAV imagery, the AVVG [ 187 ] created a high-resolution vehicle VG dataset, which provides fine-grained attributes including vehicle color, brand, and model.
blocks.zh: 对非常大规模的RS图像的处理对目前RS MLLMs构成系统的挑战,涉及数据、算法和计算资源的维度。 从数据基础的角度来看,建立高质量基准和培训数据集的费用仍然过高。 此类图像需要以塞族共和国专业领域知识为依据的精细说明。 虽然纯粹的人工注释可以确保质量,但效率受到限制。 例如,如XLRS-Bench [150] 等基准的制定,需要对单一图像提出几十项任务;这种极其耗时的性质直接制约了大规模、高质量和背景丰富的数据的积累。 AVVG[187]通过对4K UAV图像的人工注释,创建了高分辨率车辆VG数据集,提供了精细的属性,包括车辆颜色,品牌,以及模型.

blocks.en: At the model input and information retention level, a fundamental contradiction exists. Drastically compressing imagery with tens of thousands of pixels down to the standard size acceptable for models results in a severe loss of rich spatial contextual information and fine object details [ 263 ] . Conversely, avoiding compression is often infeasible as the original image dimensions far exceed the processing limits of most models, preventing them from effectively capturing long-range dependencies. Since the core of RS interpretation is precise measurement of surface information, this contradiction ultimately results in subpar model performance in critical tasks such as object counting and fine-grained object identification.
blocks.zh: 在模型输入和信息保存水平上,存在着一个根本的矛盾. 用数以万计的像素对图像进行弹性压缩,使其降低到模型可接受的标准尺寸,导致丰富的空间背景信息和精细物体细节的严重丢失[263]. 反之,避免压缩往往不可行,因为原始图像维度远远超过大多数模型的处理限度,使其无法有效捕捉长距离依赖. 由于RS解释的核心是精确测量表面信息,这一矛盾最终导致在对象计数和细纹对象识别等关键任务中子化模型性能.

blocks.en: Furthermore, analyzing internal processing efficiency highlights the pronounced challenge posed by the low semantic density characteristic of RS imagery. Vast areas of ineffective background, such as oceans and forests, prompt the visual encoder to generate a massive number of redundant visual tokens [ 171 ] . These tokens contain minor meaningful semantics, consume scarce computational resources, and can interfere with the modeling of crucial targets.
blocks.zh: 此外,分析内部处理效率突出显示RS图像的低语义密度特征所构成的显著挑战。 海洋和森林等背景无效的大片区域,促使视觉编码器生成大量冗余视觉符号[171]. 这些符文包含一些小有意义的语义,消耗了稀缺的计算资源,并且可以干扰关键目标的建模.

blocks.en: In summary, addressing these challenges requires continued and in-depth exploration from researchers in areas such as data and image construction, model algorithm innovation [ 264 ] , and the development of evaluation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 简言之,应对这些挑战需要研究人员在数据和图像构建、模型算法创新[264]以及制定评价基准等领域继续深入探索。

blocks.en: VIII-C Multi-source RS Imagery
blocks.zh: VIII-C 多源RS图像

blocks.en: Currently, a critical limitation in the field is that the vast majority of existing automatic and semi-automatic vision-language data construction pipelines are still largely restricted to optical imagery, due to the lack of powerful and reliable intelligent agents capable of processing multi-spectral [ 108 ] , synthetic aperture radar (SAR) [ 132 ] , and other specialized remote sensing (RS) modalities. This makes it difficult for existing general-purpose MLLMs to directly and accurately interpret their visual content, thereby severely degrading the reliability of automatically and semi-automatically generated image-text paired data. Particularly for SAR images, their nature as syntheses of radar echoes necessitates deep domain expertise for object recognition, posing substantial difficulties for automated data annotation.
blocks.zh: 目前,该领域的一个关键限制是,由于缺乏能够处理多光谱[108]、合成孔径雷达[132]和其他专门遥感(RS)模式的强大和可靠的智能剂,现有的绝大多数自动和半自动视觉语言数据构建管道仍然基本上局限于光学图像。 这使得现有的通用的MLLMs难以直接和准确地解释其视觉内容,从而严重地降低了自动生成和半自动生成的图像文本配对数据的可靠性. 特别是对于合成孔径雷达图像而言,其作为雷达回声的合成体的性质要求具备识别物体的深域专门知识,这给自动数据注释带来了很大困难。

blocks.en: To address this challenge, the community has explored various innovative solutions. One effective strategy is modality transfer. For instance, the SARLANG-1M [ 132 ] dataset adopts this approach by leveraging paired SAR and optical images: a general vision-language model first generates descriptions for the more interpretable optical images, and these descriptions are then transferred to the corresponding SAR images as textual annotations. This method skillfully circumvents the difficulty of directly interpreting specialized imagery, though it usually still requires expert manual review to ensure final quality. Another approach involves constructing more sophisticated automated annotation frameworks to improve description quality. For example, SAR-TEXT [ 133 ] developed a pipeline that first uses a model to generate preliminary captions from optical images, simultaneously converting segmented images into textual descriptions via algorithms, and then feeds both pieces of information into a large language model. Leveraging its in-context learning capability, the framework produces high-quality, detailed descriptions. Although this method demands higher input requirements (paired SAR images, optical images, and segmentation maps), it can yield very fine-grained annotations. When paired optical images are unavailable, researchers have also explored methods that do not rely on external paired data. The SARCAP [ 130 ] dataset provides a typical example: it directly utilizes existing object detection or semantic segmentation annotations of SAR images. It generates corresponding textual descriptions based on predefined rules and templates. Similarly, the OSVQA [ 174 ] dataset first annotates basic attributes of images under expert guidance and then uses templates to generate diverse visual question-answer pairs. This approach fully exploits the potential of existing specialized datasets, enabling the construction of valuable vision-language data even with a single data modality. Furthermore, by automatically associating large-scale unlabeled RS imagery with rich semantic information from open geoinformation databases, large-scale and semantically diverse datasets can also be built, as successfully demonstrated by the SkyScript [ 135 ] dataset.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,国际社会探索了各种创新的解决办法。 一个有效的战略是模式转让。 例如,SARLANG-1M[132]数据集采用这种方法,利用配对合成孔径雷达和光学图像:一般视觉语言模型首先生成更可解释的光学图像的描述,然后将这些描述作为文字说明转移到相应的合成孔径雷达图像。 这种方法巧妙地避免了直接解释专门图像的困难,尽管它通常仍然需要专家人工审查以确保最终质量。 另一种做法是构建更复杂的自动注释框架,以提高描述质量。 例如,SAR-TEXT[133]开发了一条管道,首先使用模型从光学图像中生成初步标题,同时通过算法将片段图像转换成文字描述,然后将两段信息输入一个大语言模型. 该框架利用其内文学习能力,产生高质量的详细描述。 虽然这种方法需要更高的输入要求(被保有的合成孔径雷达图像,光学图像,以及分片图),但它可以产生非常精细的注释. 当配对光学图像无法获取时,研究人员也探索了不依赖外部配对数据的方法. SARCAP [130] 数据集提供了一个典型的例子:它直接利用现有对象检测或SAR图像的语义分解说明. 它根据预先定义的规则和模板生成相应的文字描述. 同样,OSVQA[174]数据集首先在专家指导下对图像的基本属性进行注释,然后使用模板生成多种视觉问答对. 这种方法充分利用了现有专门数据集的潜力,即使采用单一数据模式,也能够构建有价值的视觉语言数据。 此外,通过自动将大规模无标签的RS图象与开放的地理信息数据库中丰富的语义信息联系起来,也可以建立大规模和精密多样的数据集,SkyScript[135]数据集成功证明了这一点。

blocks.en: It is worth noting that the core ideas behind the above methodologies are not limited to addressing data construction for SAR imagery. They possess high generalizability and transfer value and can be effectively applied to other specialized RS data domains. For instance, in modalities such as nighttime light [ 270 ] and thermal infrared [ 271 ] RS imagery, which also face annotation difficulties, these approaches can provide important references for constructing high-quality vision-language datasets.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,上述方法背后的核心思想并不限于解决合成孔径雷达图像的数据构建问题。 它们具有很高的通性和转让价值,可以有效地应用于其他专业的RS数据领域。 例如,在夜光[270]和热红外线[271]RS图像等模式中,这些方法也面临注释困难,可以为建造高质量的视觉语言数据集提供重要的参考。

blocks.en: VIII-D UAV Imagery
blocks.zh: 八维无人驾驶航空器 图像

blocks.en: Embodied intelligence has emerged as a prominent frontier in AI research [ 12 ] . UAVs, often referred to as aerial robots, situate themselves at the intersection of embodied intelligence and RS technologies. Existing vision-language datasets for UAVs are expanding beyond foundational capabilities, such as navigation [ 189 , 272 ] , to progressively encompass diverse competency dimensions, including 3D spatial perception [ 215 , 273 ] , mathematical reasoning [ 155 ] , complex decision-making [ 158 ] , multi-agent collaboration [ 274 ] , and security assurance [ 275 ] . As a critical enabler for the development of aerial embodied intelligence, these UAV vision-language datasets are constructing a comprehensive capability framework that spans perception, cognition, decision-making, collaboration, and safety, thereby propelling the field from basic environmental awareness towards deep human-UAV interaction and sophisticated decision-making.
blocks.zh: 健美的情报在AI研究中成为了突出的前沿[12]. 无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs),常被称为航空机器人,坐落在体现的智能和RS技术的交汇处. 用于无人驾驶飞行器的现有视觉语言数据集正在扩大,超出了基础能力,例如导航[189,272],逐渐包括各种能力层面,包括3D空间感知[215,273],数学推理[155],复杂的决策[158],多代理协作[274],以及安全保证[275]。 这些无人驾驶飞行器的视觉语言数据集作为开发航空内含情报的关键手段,正在构建一个涵盖感知、认知、决策、协作和安全的全面能力框架,从而推动实地从基本环境意识向人类与无人驾驶飞行器的深度互动和复杂的决策发展。

blocks.en: Through the efficient integration of simulated and real-world data [ 272 , 276 ] , coupled with deep learning from multimodal and multi-agent technologies [ 277 ] , UAVs hold significant potential to evolve from passive aerial cameras that merely execute tasks into proactive, embodied agents capable of autonomous environmental perception, intent understanding, interactive collaboration, and independent decision-making.
blocks.zh: 通过有效整合模拟数据和实际世界数据[272,276],加上从多式联运和多剂技术中深入学习[277],无人驾驶飞行器具有很大潜力,可以从被动的航空照相机演变成主动的、具有自主环境感知、意向理解、互动协作和独立决策能力的内含物。

blocks.en: VIII-E Agentic AI in RS
blocks.zh: 塞族共和国的代理AI

blocks.en: One of the most remarkable advancements in the current AI domain is the rapid development of AI agents. These agents not only represent a key direction of technological evolution, but are also regarded by industries as a critical force for fostering new productive forces. However, a significant bottleneck that hinders the progress of AI agents from RS lies in the acquisition and construction of high-quality task-specific datasets. This process faces three core challenges. First, the field involves extremely high expertise barriers. RS interpretation relies on profound knowledge of Earth sciences. Tasks such as land surface temperature retrieval or nighttime light analysis [ 270 ] involve complex physical models and specialized interpretation rules. Consequently, data annotation must be performed by domain experts, leading to high costs and prolonged cycles. Second, task logic is inherently complex. Practical RS workflows, like disaster assessment or environmental monitoring, often require multi-step quantitative reasoning and the coordinated invocation of various specialized tools, for example, spectral index calculation [ 267 ] or change detection models [ 53 ] . This imposes stringent requirements on the design and validation of task sequences within datasets. Third, data and task formats are highly heterogeneous. The diversity of RS data sources and the dispersion of task objectives make standardized, large-scale annotation exceptionally difficult.
blocks.zh: 目前AI领域最显著的进步之一是AI代理的快速发展. 这些代理人不仅代表着技术演变的关键方向,而且被工业视为培育新的生产力量的关键力量. 然而,阻碍斯普斯卡共和国AI代理人员进步的一个重大瓶颈在于获取和建造高质量的特定任务数据集。 这一进程面临三个核心挑战。 首先,该领域涉及极高的专业知识障碍。 RS的解释依赖于对地球科学的深刻了解. 陆地表面温度检索或夜间光线分析等任务[270]涉及复杂的物理模型和专门解释规则. 因此,数据说明必须由域专家进行,导致成本高和周期长。 第二,任务逻辑本质上是复杂的。 实际的RS工作流程,如灾害评估或环境监测,往往需要多步骤的定量推理和协调地引用各种专门工具,例如光谱指数计算[267]或变化探测模型[53]. 这对数据集内的任务序列的设计和验证提出了严格的要求. 第三,数据和任务格式差异很大。 塞族共和国数据来源的多样性和任务目标的分散,使得标准化的大规模说明特别困难。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, current research primarily depends on manual construction paradigms. For instance, datasets like UnivEarth [ 178 ] and GeoPlan-Bench [ 165 ] employ a reverse engineering approach, deriving questions from existing scientific reports or predefined tool pathways to ensure answer accuracy and verifiability. The ThinkGeo [ 177 ] dataset comprises expert-designed and validated reasoning chains, encompassing thousands of steps to ensure logical rigor. Earth-Bench further encapsulates domain knowledge into hundreds of standardized tools, constructing problems around tool combinations. These methods collectively form the mainstream benchmarking frameworks, providing valuable high-quality standards for evaluating the fundamental capabilities of AI agents. However, their fundamental limitation is the deep reliance on expert-led design, annotation, and validation. This results in constrained dataset scales, typically limited to a few hundred or thousands of samples, poor scalability, difficulty in covering real-world long-tail scenarios, and a nature more suited for testing rather than training sets.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,目前的研究主要取决于人工建筑范式. 例如,UnivEarth[178]和GeoPlan-Bench[165]等数据集采用反向工程方法,从现有的科学报告或预先确定的工具路径中得出问题,以确保答案的准确性和可核查性。 ThinkGeo [177] 数据集由专家设计并经过验证的推理链组成,包括数千个步骤,以确保逻辑严格。 Earth-Bench将域知识进一步囊括成数百种标准化工具,围绕工具组合构建问题. 这些方法共同构成了主流基准框架,为评估人工智能代理人的基本能力提供了宝贵的高质量标准。 然而,它们的根本局限性是严重依赖专家主导的设计、注释和验证。 这造成数据集尺度有限,通常限于几百或数千个样本,可扩展性差,难以涵盖现实世界的长尾假想,性质更适合测试而非培训。

blocks.en: Therefore, breaking through the data scale bottleneck is crucial for advancing this field. Establishing sustainable, low-cost, and high-quality data augmentation mechanisms represents an urgent and promising research direction to unlock the practical application potential of RS AI agents.
blocks.zh: 因此,打破数据规模的瓶颈对于推进这一领域至关重要。 建立可持续、低成本和高质量的数据增强机制,是释放塞族共和国人工智能人员实际应用潜力的紧迫和有希望的研究方向。

blocks.en: VIII-F RS Application Scenarios
blocks.zh: VIII-F RS 应用程序设想

blocks.en: Building high-quality, domain-specific datasets is pivotal for advancing RS technology from mere perception to deeper cognition and informed decision-making. Their core value lies in bridging the gap between general-purpose MLLMs and the specialized demands of the field. By infusing models with expert domain knowledge, these datasets enable an understanding of the unique perspectives, professional geo-objects, and technical terminology characteristic of RS imagery. This capability is fundamental for supporting complex analytical and decision-making tasks, such as disaster assessment [ 164 ] and urban planning [ 162 ] . Furthermore, such datasets form the cornerstone of natural human-machine interaction, allowing experts to efficiently query data using intuitive instructions like analyzing road blockages after an earthquake, thereby significantly boosting operational efficiency [ 88 ] .
blocks.zh: 建立高质量的、针对具体领域的数据组,对于将RS技术从单纯的认知提升到更深入的认知和知情决策至关重要。 其核心价值在于缩小普通用途小额供资和微型企业与外地专门需求之间的差距。 这些数据集使模型具有专家领域知识,从而能够了解RS图像的独特视角、专业地理物体和技术术语特征。 这种能力对于支持复杂的分析和决策任务至关重要,例如灾害评估[164]和城市规划[162]。 此外,这类数据集构成自然人机互动的基石,使专家能够利用直观指示,如分析地震后的道路阻塞,有效地查询数据,从而大大提高运行效率[88]。

blocks.en: However, the construction process is fraught with challenges. The primary hurdle is achieving annotation expertise and consistency. Interpreting RS images requires profound domain knowledge, making precise annotation inherently costly. To ensure quality, a human-machine collaborative strategy is often essential, typically involving AI-powered initial screening followed by verification by domain experts, supplemented by rigorous annotator training, cross-validation, and expert sampling audits [ 220 ] . Another critical challenge is balancing task design, scientificity, and practicality. Datasets must not only pursue high-precision metrics but also effectively address real-world industry pain points. This demands a deep understanding of business logic from builders, who must design diverse problems, correlate multi-source economic data, and even simulate real disaster scenarios to ensure the data underpins effective decision-making. Ultimately, striking a balance between data scale, quality, and cost is crucial. A feasible path currently involves leveraging AI-assisted generation with expert oversight to strike a balance between efficiency and quality.
blocks.zh: 然而,建造过程充满挑战。 主要障碍是获得说明专门知识和一致性。 解释RS图像需要深入的域知识,准确的注释本身成本高昂。 为确保质量,人机合作战略往往至关重要,通常包括人工智能驱动的初步筛选,然后由域专家进行核查,辅之以严格的注释员培训、交叉验证和专家抽样审计[220]。 另一个重大挑战是平衡任务设计、科学性和实用性。 数据集不仅必须追求高精度的衡量标准,而且还必须有效处理现实世界的行业痛点。 这就要求建设者深入了解业务逻辑,他们必须设计各种各样的问题,将多来源经济数据联系起来,甚至模拟真正的灾害情景,以确保数据支持有效的决策。 最终,在数据规模、质量和成本之间取得平衡至关重要。 目前可行的途径是利用AI协助的一代专家监督,在效率和质量之间取得平衡。

blocks.en: IX Conclusion
blocks.zh: 九. 结论

blocks.en: This paper concludes by presenting a comprehensive, data-centric guide for tailoring Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in RS, centered on the novel GeoChef framework that systematizes the entire pipeline from dataset curation to model evaluation. Through a systematic survey of over 120 vision-language datasets, a detailed taxonomy, and a community-driven data warehouse, we provide practical methodologies for constructing, fine-tuning, and assessing MLLMs, empowering researchers to overcome resource constraints and achieve specialized model performance. We anticipate that this work can provide practical guidance for academia and industry, promoting the development of more diverse and higher-quality vision-language datasets for specialized RS fields. Ultimately, our long-term vision is to enable the organic integration of these scattered data resources, gradually forming a comprehensive, geographically widespread, and annotation-standardized super RS vision-language corpus. This will not only serve as the foundation for efficient and reproducible research and development but also lay a solid and indispensable data cornerstone for advancing toward a GeoAI with robust generalization and cognitive capabilities.
blocks.zh: 本文最后介绍了一个综合、以数据为中心的指南,用于在塞尔维亚定制多式联运大语言模型,其核心是小说中的GeoChef框架,该框架将整个管道从数据集库到模型评价系统化。 通过对120多个视觉语言数据集的系统调查,详细的分类学,以及社区驱动的数据仓库,我们提供了构建,微调和评估MLLM的实用方法,使研究人员有能力克服资源限制,实现专业化的模型性能. 我们预计,这项工作可以为学术界和工业界提供实际指导,促进为塞尔维亚专业领域开发更加多样和高质量的愿景语言数据集。 归根结底,我们的长期愿景是使这些分散的数据资源有机地融合,逐步形成一个全面、地域广泛和注解标准化的超级RS远景语言体。 这不仅将成为高效和可复制的研究和开发的基础,而且也为推进具有强大通用和认知能力的GeoAI奠定坚实和不可或缺的数据基石。
